```{r setup_paths, include=FALSE}
library(haven)

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd(), target = "Data_center_and_fossil_energy_Replication") {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (basename(current) == target) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop(
        "Project root not found. Run this Rmd from inside ", target,
        " or set the working directory to the replication repository."
      )
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}

base_path <- find_project_root()

path_raw     <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "raw")
path_temp    <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "temp")
path_use     <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "use")
path_figures <- file.path(base_path, "Results", "Figures")
path_tables  <- file.path(base_path, "Results", "Tables")

data <- read_dta(file.path(path_use, "gem_coal_plants_multi_record_sa_dce_robust_forR_clean.dta"))
```


```{r main_fig3a_baseline_cox}
library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# Define DCE exposure variables by commissioning period and spatial definition
types <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

exposure_specs <- list(
  "15km"  = paste0("ai_proximity_15km_", types),
  "25km"  = paste0("ai_proximity_25km_", types),
  "50km"  = paste0("ai_proximity_50km_", types),
  "100km" = paste0("ai_proximity_100km_", types),
  "200km" = paste0("ai_proximity_200km_", types),
  "GID_1" = paste0("ai_gid1_", types),
  "GID_2" = paste0("ai_gid2_", types)
)

results_list <- list()
cox_models_list <- list()

# Estimate Cox models for each spatial exposure definition
for (spec_name in names(exposure_specs)) {
  
  proximity_vars <- exposure_specs[[spec_name]]
  proximity_formula <- paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + ")
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    proximity_formula,
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year", 
    " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
    " + td_loss_pct_output",
    " + demand_yoy_pct",
    " + renew_gen_share_pct",
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    
    cox_model <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str), 
      data = data,
      cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
    )
    
    coef_summary <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients
    has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
    
    n_obs <- cox_model$n
    n_events <- cox_model$nevent
    
    for (i in seq_along(types)) {
      type <- types[i]
      var_name <- proximity_vars[i]
      
      if (!(var_name %in% rownames(coef_summary))) {
        cat(sprintf("  ! Variable not estimated: %s in spec %s\n", var_name, spec_name))
        next
      }
      
      if (has_robust) {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[var_name, "robust se"]
        pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      } else {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[var_name, "se(coef)"]
        pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      }
      
      hr <- exp(coef_val)
      ci_lower <- exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se)
      ci_upper <- exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se)
      
      result_row <- data.frame(
        Specification = spec_name,
        Type = type,
        Variable = var_name,
        Coefficient = coef_val,
        HR = hr,
        SE = se,
        CI_lower = ci_lower,
        CI_upper = ci_upper,
        P_value = pval,
        Sig = case_when(
          pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
          pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        N_obs = n_obs,
        N_events = n_events
      )
      
      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- result_row
    }
    
    cox_models_list[[spec_name]] <- list(
      model = cox_model,
      specification = spec_name,
      formula = formula_str
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("✓ Successfully fitted model for specification: %s\n", spec_name))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("✗ Error in specification %s: %s\n", spec_name, e$message))
  })
}

# Save model outputs used for Fig. 3a and Supplementary Table 3
if (length(results_list) == 0) {
  stop("No models successfully fitted!")
}

results_df <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Specification_order = case_when(
      Specification == "15km" ~ 15,
      Specification == "25km" ~ 25,
      Specification == "50km" ~ 50,
      Specification == "100km" ~ 100,
      Specification == "200km" ~ 200,
      Specification == "GID_1" ~ 1001,
      Specification == "GID_2" ~ 1002,
      TRUE ~ 9999
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Specification_order, Type)

saveRDS(results_df, file.path(path_temp, "cox_baseline_spatial_results.rds"))
saveRDS(cox_models_list, file.path(path_temp, "cox_baseline_spatial_models.rds"))
write.csv(results_df, file.path(path_tables, "sup_table03_baseline_cox_source.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nAnalysis completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Total specifications fitted: %d\n", length(cox_models_list)))
cat(sprintf("Total coefficients: %d\n", nrow(results_df)))
cat(sprintf("Significant results (p < 0.05): %d\n", sum(results_df$P_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))

print(results_df %>%
        dplyr::select(Specification, Type, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig, N_obs))

```

```{r main_fig3a_plot}
library(grid)
library(gtable)
library(ggplot2)

# Load saved model results

  stop("Results file not found! Please run Cox regression first.")

# Figure style settings

FONT_FAMILY <- "sans"
FONT_SIZE_BASE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_TITLE <- 12
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT <- 9
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_LEGEND <- 9
FONT_SIZE_CAPTION <- 8

LINE_WIDTH_AXIS <- 0.5
LINE_WIDTH_ERROR <- 0.8
POINT_SIZE <- 1.5
POINT_STROKE <- 1.2

AXIS_TEXT_MARGIN <- 4
AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN <- 8
LEGEND_KEY_SIZE <- 0.5

FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH <- unit(1.2, "cm")  
FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH <- unit(1.5, "cm")   

nature_colors <- c(
  "before06" = "#000080",
  "06_15" = "#4169E1",
  "16_19" = "#9E1C60",
  "20_24" = "#FF4500"
)

period_labels <- c(
  "before06" = "Before 2006",
  "06_15" = "2006-2015",
  "16_19" = "2016-2019",
  "20_24" = "2020-2024"
)

period_order <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

theme_nature_standard <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY),
      plot.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_TITLE, hjust = 0, 
                                margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, hjust = 0, 
                                   margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_CAPTION, hjust = 0, 
                                  color = "grey20", margin = margin(t = 8), 
                                  lineheight = 1.1),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black",
                                 margin = margin(t = AXIS_TEXT_MARGIN)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, 
        color = "black",
        hjust = 1.1,              
        vjust = 1.1,              
        angle = -30,              
        margin = margin(r = 4)
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
                                  margin = margin(t = AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
        angle = 90,               
        margin = margin(r = AXIS_TITLE_MARGIN)
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.position = "none",  
      plot.margin = margin(12, 40, 12, 20),  
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

# Keep the baseline 25 km specification for Fig. 3a
plot1_data <- results_df %>%
  mutate(
    Specification = as.character(Specification),
    Type = as.character(Type)
  ) %>%
  filter(Specification == "25km") %>%
  mutate(
    Type_clean = case_when(
      Type == "before06" ~ "Before 2006",
      Type == "06_15" ~ "2006-2015",
      Type == "16_19" ~ "2016-2019",
      Type == "20_24" ~ "2020-2024",
      TRUE ~ Type
    ),
    Type_factor = factor(
      Type_clean,
      levels = c("Before 2006", "2006-2015", "2016-2019", "2020-2024")
    ),
    plot_order = case_when(
      Type_clean == "Before 2006" ~ 4,
      Type_clean == "2006-2015" ~ 3,
      Type_clean == "2016-2019" ~ 2,
      Type_clean == "2020-2024" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

if (nrow(plot1_data) == 0) {
  stop("No 25km results found. Check that results_df$Specification contains '25km'.")
}

x_min <- min(plot1_data$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(plot1_data$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range <- x_max - x_min

x_limit_min <- x_min - 0.18 * x_range
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.36 * x_range

x_breaks <- pretty(c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max), n = 4)

plot1_data <- plot1_data %>%
  mutate(
    label_x = pmin(
      CI_upper + 0.035 * x_range,
      x_limit_max - 0.08 * x_range
    ),
    hr_label = sprintf("%.3f%s", HR, Sig)
  )

forest_plot_25km <- ggplot(plot1_data, aes(x = HR, y = plot_order)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "solid",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper, color = Type),
    height = 0,
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Type, fill = Type),
    shape = 21,
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, label = hr_label, color = Type),
    hjust = 0,
    size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.35,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE,
    family = FONT_FAMILY
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = nature_colors,
    labels = period_labels,
    breaks = period_order
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "before06" = "white",
      "06_15" = "white",
      "16_19" = "white",
      "20_24" = "white"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Data center construction periods"
  ) +
  theme_nature_standard() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max),
    breaks = x_breaks,
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c("2020-2024", "2016-2019", "2006-2015", "Before 2006"),
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))
  )

plot1_grob <- ggplotGrob(forest_plot_25km)
plot1_grob$widths[2] <- FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH
plot1_grob$widths[3] <- FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH

ggsave(
```

```{r sup_fig05_robustness_models}
names(specs) <- map_chr(specs, 1)

build_formula <- function(exposure_vars, controls, adjustment, cluster_var) {
  rhs <- c(exposure_vars, controls)

  if (adjustment == "country") {
    rhs <- c(rhs, "strata(Alpha_3_code)")
  }

  if (adjustment == "country_post2020_strata") {
    rhs <- c(rhs, "strata(country_post2020_strata)")
  }

  if (adjustment == "country_year_strata") {
    rhs <- c(rhs, "strata(country_year_strata)")
  }

  rhs <- c(rhs, paste0("cluster(", cluster_var, ")"))

  paste0("Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ", paste(rhs, collapse = " + "))
}

extract_coefs <- function(model, spec, exposure_vars, cluster_var, n_clusters) {
  coef_summary <- summary(model)$coefficients
  has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)

  rows <- list()

  for (var_name in exposure_vars) {
    if (!(var_name %in% rownames(coef_summary))) next

    coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
    se <- if (has_robust) coef_summary[var_name, "robust se"] else coef_summary[var_name, "se(coef)"]
    pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]

    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Spec_id = spec[[1]],
      Category = spec[[2]],
      Spec_label = spec[[3]],
      Variable = var_name,
      Focal = var_name == tail(exposure_vars, 1),
      Cluster_var = cluster_var,
      N_clusters = n_clusters,
      Coefficient = coef_val,
      SE = se,
      HR = exp(coef_val),
      CI90_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.645 * se),
      CI90_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.645 * se),
      CI95_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se),
      CI95_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se),
      P_value = pval,
      Sig = case_when(
        pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
        pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
        pval < 0.10 ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      N_obs = model$n,
      N_events = model$nevent,
      Plot_order = spec[[7]]
    )
  }

  bind_rows(rows)
}

results_all <- list()
models_all <- list()

for (spec in specs) {
  spec_id <- spec[[1]]
  exposure_vars <- spec[[4]]
  controls <- spec[[5]]
  adjustment <- spec[[6]]
  cluster_var <- spec[[8]]

  needed <- unique(c(
    exposure_vars, controls, cluster_var,
    "time0", "time1", "retire",
    "GEM_unit_phase_ID", "Alpha_3_code"
  ))

  if (adjustment == "country_post2020_strata") {
    needed <- unique(c(needed, "country_post2020_strata"))
  }

  if (adjustment == "country_year_strata") {
    needed <- unique(c(needed, "country_year_strata"))
  }

  missing_vars <- setdiff(needed, names(data_sens))
  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("Skipped %s. Missing variables: %s\n", spec_id, paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")))
    next
  }

  data_used <- data_sens %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[cluster_var]]))

  formula_str <- build_formula(exposure_vars, controls, adjustment, cluster_var)

  cat(sprintf("\nRunning %s: %s | cluster = %s\n", spec_id, spec[[3]], cluster_var))

  fit <- tryCatch({
    coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str),
      data = data_used,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 300)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("  Error in %s: %s\n", spec_id, e$message))
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(fit)) next

  n_clusters <- n_distinct(data_used[[cluster_var]])

  models_all[[spec_id]] <- list(
    model = fit,
    formula = formula_str,
    spec = spec,
    cluster_var = cluster_var,
    n_clusters = n_clusters
  )

  results_all[[spec_id]] <- extract_coefs(
    model = fit,
    spec = spec,
    exposure_vars = exposure_vars,
    cluster_var = cluster_var,
    n_clusters = n_clusters
  )

  cat(sprintf(
    "  Finished %s | N = %s | events = %s | clusters = %s\n",
    spec_id, fit$n, fit$nevent, n_clusters
  ))
}

sensitivity_results_all <- bind_rows(results_all) %>%
  arrange(Plot_order, Variable)

sensitivity_results_focal <- sensitivity_results_all %>%
  filter(Focal) %>%
  arrange(Plot_order)

saveRDS(sensitivity_results_all, file.path(path_temp, "cox_robustness_all_coefficients.rds"))
saveRDS(sensitivity_results_focal, file.path(path_temp, "cox_robustness_focal_results.rds"))
saveRDS(models_all, file.path(path_temp, "cox_robustness_models.rds"))

write.csv(sensitivity_results_all, file.path(path_tables, "cox_robustness_all_coefficients.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sensitivity_results_focal, file.path(path_tables, "cox_robustness_focal_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

print(sensitivity_results_focal %>%
        select(Category, Spec_label, Cluster_var, N_clusters, Variable,
               HR, CI95_lower, CI95_upper, P_value, Sig, N_obs, N_events))
```

```{r fig_3b_marginal_survival_curves_calculation_session}

library(survival)
library(dplyr)

cox_models_list <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "cox_baseline_spatial_models.rds"))

model_key <- "25km"
var_name <- "ai_proximity_25km_20_24"

cat(sprintf("Loading model: %s\n", model_key))
cat(sprintf("Target variable: %s\n\n", var_name))

if (!(model_key %in% names(cox_models_list))) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Model '%s' not found. Available model keys are: %s",
    model_key,
    paste(names(cox_models_list), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

model_obj <- cox_models_list[[model_key]]
cox_model <- if (inherits(model_obj, "coxph")) model_obj else model_obj$model

if (is.null(cox_model)) {
  stop(sprintf("Model '%s' does not contain a Cox model object.", model_key))
}

required_vars <- c(
  "ai_proximity_25km_before06",
  "ai_proximity_25km_06_15",
  "ai_proximity_25km_16_19",
  "ai_proximity_25km_20_24",
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct",
  "Alpha_3_code"
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(data))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing variables:", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")))
}

data_curve <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Alpha_3_code = factor(Alpha_3_code)
  ) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(required_vars), ~ !is.na(.)))

cat(sprintf("Analysis sample for survival curves: N = %d\n\n", nrow(data_curve)))

min_val <- min(data_curve[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
exposed_vals <- data_curve[[var_name]][data_curve[[var_name]] > min_val]
mean_exposed <- mean(exposed_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Exposure levels:\n")
cat(sprintf("  No exposure: %.4f\n", min_val))
cat(sprintf("  Exposed mean among exposed units: %.4f\n\n", mean_exposed))

strata_info <- data_curve %>%
  group_by(Alpha_3_code) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(weight = n / sum(n))

cat(sprintf("Total strata: %d\n\n", nrow(strata_info)))

continuous_vars <- c(
  "ai_proximity_25km_before06",
  "ai_proximity_25km_06_15",
  "ai_proximity_25km_16_19",
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct"
)

global_means <- sapply(
  continuous_vars,
  function(v) mean(data_curve[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
)

strata_curves <- list()
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(strata_info), style = 3)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(strata_info))) {
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  strata_row <- strata_info[i, ]

  tryCatch({

    template_row <- data_curve %>%
      filter(Alpha_3_code == strata_row$Alpha_3_code) %>%
      slice(1)

    if (nrow(template_row) == 0) next

    newdata_no_ai <- template_row[, required_vars, drop = FALSE]
    newdata_ai <- template_row[, required_vars, drop = FALSE]

    for (v in continuous_vars) {
      newdata_no_ai[[v]] <- global_means[[v]]
      newdata_ai[[v]] <- global_means[[v]]
    }

    newdata_no_ai[[var_name]] <- min_val
    newdata_ai[[var_name]] <- mean_exposed

    surv_no_ai <- suppressWarnings(survfit(cox_model, newdata = newdata_no_ai))
    surv_ai <- suppressWarnings(survfit(cox_model, newdata = newdata_ai))

    if (length(surv_no_ai$time) == 0 || length(surv_ai$time) == 0) next

    strata_curves[[length(strata_curves) + 1]] <- list(
      no_ai = data.frame(
        time = surv_no_ai$time,
        surv = surv_no_ai$surv,
        weight = strata_row$weight
      ),
      ai = data.frame(
        time = surv_ai$time,
        surv = surv_ai$surv,
        weight = strata_row$weight
      ),
      country = as.character(strata_row$Alpha_3_code),
      n = strata_row$n
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\nError in strata %d (%s): %s\n",
      i,
      as.character(strata_row$Alpha_3_code),
      e$message
    ))
  })
}

close(pb)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nSuccessfully processed: %d/%d strata\n\n",
  length(strata_curves), nrow(strata_info)
))

if (length(strata_curves) == 0) {
  stop("No strata successfully processed.")
}

all_times_no_ai <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(strata_curves, function(x) x$no_ai$time))))
all_times_ai <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(strata_curves, function(x) x$ai$time))))

calc_weighted_surv <- function(time_points, curves_list, scenario) {
  sapply(time_points, function(t) {
    surv_at_t <- sapply(curves_list, function(curve) {
      curve_data <- curve[[scenario]]
      idx <- which(curve_data$time <= t)
      if (length(idx) > 0) curve_data$surv[max(idx)] else 1
    })

    weights <- sapply(curves_list, function(x) x[[scenario]]$weight[1])
    sum(surv_at_t * weights) / sum(weights)
  })
}

surv_no_ai_marginal <- calc_weighted_surv(all_times_no_ai, strata_curves, "no_ai")
surv_ai_marginal <- calc_weighted_surv(all_times_ai, strata_curves, "ai")

survival_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    time = 0,
    Survival = 1,
    AI_Status = "No AI Exposure"
  ),
  data.frame(
    time = 0,
    Survival = 1,
    AI_Status = "AI Exposure"
  ),
  data.frame(
    time = all_times_no_ai,
    Survival = surv_no_ai_marginal,
    AI_Status = "No AI Exposure"
  ),
  data.frame(
    time = all_times_ai,
    Survival = surv_ai_marginal,
    AI_Status = "AI Exposure"
  )
) %>%
  arrange(AI_Status, time) %>%
  mutate(
    AI_Status = factor(
      AI_Status,
      levels = c("No AI Exposure", "AI Exposure")
    )
  )

saveRDS(
  survival_df,
  file.path(path_temp, "main_fig3b_survival_data.rds")
)

write.csv(
  survival_df,
  file.path(path_tables, "main_fig3b_survival_data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

metadata <- list(
  model_key = model_key,
  var_name = var_name,
  min_val = min_val,
  mean_exposed = mean_exposed,
  n_strata = length(strata_curves),
  n_exposed = length(exposed_vals),
  n_analysis = nrow(data_curve),
  controls = continuous_vars
)

saveRDS(
  metadata,
  file.path(path_temp, "main_fig3b_survival_metadata.rds")
)
```

```{r fig_3b_marginal_survival_curves_plot_session}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)
library(gtable)

# Figure style settings
FONT_FAMILY <- "sans"
FONT_SIZE_BASE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_TITLE <- 12
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT <- 9
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_LEGEND <- 9
FONT_SIZE_CAPTION <- 8

LINE_WIDTH_AXIS <- 0.5
LINE_WIDTH_CURVE <- 0.8
LINE_WIDTH_DIFF <- 0.6
LEGEND_KEY_SIZE <- 0.8

COLOR_NO_DC <- "#360185"
COLOR_DC <- "#DE1A58"
COLOR_DIFF <- "#FF8C00"

theme_nature_standard <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY),
      plot.title = element_blank(),  
      plot.subtitle = element_blank(),  
      plot.caption = element_blank(), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black",
                                 margin = margin(t = 4)),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black",
                                 margin = margin(r = 4)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
                                  margin = margin(t = 8)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, 
                                  margin = margin(r = 8)),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.position = "none",  
      plot.margin = margin(12, 40, 12, 10),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

# Load Data
survival_df <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "main_fig3b_survival_data.rds"))
metadata <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "main_fig3b_survival_metadata.rds"))

# Calculate the difference between the two survival curves
diff_df <- survival_df %>%
  dplyr::select(time, AI_Status, Survival) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = AI_Status, values_from = Survival) %>%
  mutate(
    Difference = `AI Exposure` - `No AI Exposure`,
    Rel_Diff_Pct = 100 * Difference / `No AI Exposure`
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Difference))

cat(sprintf("Calculated differences for %d time points\n", nrow(diff_df)))
cat(sprintf("Difference range: [%.4f, %.4f]\n\n", 
            min(diff_df$Difference), max(diff_df$Difference)))

# Set the secondary-axis range for the survival-difference curve
diff_ylim <- c(0, 0.25)

# Main Plot
survival_plot <- ggplot(survival_df, aes(x = time, y = Survival,
                                          color = AI_Status, linetype = AI_Status)) +
  # Survival curves
  geom_step(linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_CURVE) +
  
  # Difference curve (mapped to secondary axis)
  geom_step(data = diff_df, 
            aes(x = time, y = (Difference - diff_ylim[1]) / diff(diff_ylim) * 1.0),
            color = COLOR_DIFF, 
            linetype = "dashed",
            linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_DIFF,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Scales
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Survival Probability",
    limits = c(0, 1), 
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    labels = sprintf("%.2f", seq(0, 1, 0.25)),
    expand = c(0.01, 0),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ . * diff(diff_ylim) + diff_ylim[1],
      name = "Difference",
      breaks = seq(0, 0.25, by = 0.05),
      labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Operating Years",
    breaks = seq(0, max(survival_df$time), by = 10),
    expand = c(0.02, 0)
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("No AI Exposure" = COLOR_NO_DC, 
               "AI Exposure" = COLOR_DC)
  ) +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("No AI Exposure" = "solid", 
               "AI Exposure" = "solid")
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_nature_standard()

# legend
legend_x_start <- max(survival_df$time) * 0.65
legend_y_start <- 0.95
legend_spacing <- 0.08

survival_plot_final <- survival_plot +
  # No exposure
  annotate("segment", 
           x = legend_x_start, 
           xend = legend_x_start + max(survival_df$time) * 0.05,
           y = legend_y_start, 
           yend = legend_y_start,
           color = COLOR_NO_DC, 
           linetype = "solid", 
           linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_CURVE) +
  annotate("text",
           x = legend_x_start + max(survival_df$time) * 0.06,
           y = legend_y_start,
           label = "No exposure",
           hjust = 0, 
           size = 3.2, 
           color = "black") +
  
  # Exposed
  annotate("segment", 
           x = legend_x_start, 
           xend = legend_x_start + max(survival_df$time) * 0.05,
           y = legend_y_start - legend_spacing, 
           yend = legend_y_start - legend_spacing,
           color = COLOR_DC, 
           linetype = "solid", 
           linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_CURVE) +
  annotate("text",
           x = legend_x_start + max(survival_df$time) * 0.06,
           y = legend_y_start - legend_spacing,
           label = "Exposed",
           hjust = 0, 
           size = 3.2, 
           color = "black") +
  
  # Survival Difference
  annotate("segment", 
           x = legend_x_start, 
           xend = legend_x_start + max(survival_df$time) * 0.05,
           y = legend_y_start - legend_spacing * 2, 
           yend = legend_y_start - legend_spacing * 2,
           color = COLOR_DIFF, 
           linetype = "dashed", 
           linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_DIFF) +
  annotate("text",
           x = legend_x_start + max(survival_df$time) * 0.06,
           y = legend_y_start - legend_spacing * 2,
           label = "Difference",
           hjust = 0, 
           size = 3.2, 
           color = "black")

# Display
print(survival_plot_final)

# Save Plots
ggsave(
  file.path(path_figures, "fig3b.pdf"),
  plot = survival_plot_final,
  width = 5.5, 
  height = 4, 
  device = "pdf" 
)

# Export annual survival probabilities for Supplementary Table 6
cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("DETAILED YEAR-BY-YEAR SURVIVAL PROBABILITIES\n")
cat(paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""), "\n\n")

# Create a complete operational-age sequence
all_years <- seq(0, max(diff_df$time), by = 1)

detailed_output <- data.frame()

for (year in all_years) {
  year_data <- diff_df %>%
    filter(time <= year) %>%
    slice_max(time, n = 1)
  
  if (nrow(year_data) > 0) {
    detailed_output <- rbind(detailed_output, data.frame(
      Year = year,
      Actual_Time = year_data$time,
      No_DC = year_data$`No AI Exposure`,
      DC_Exposed = year_data$`AI Exposure`,
      Difference = year_data$Difference,
      Rel_Diff_Pct = year_data$Rel_Diff_Pct
    ))
  }
}

# Print annual survival probabilities
cat(sprintf("%-6s | %-12s | %-12s | %-12s | %-12s | %-12s\n",
            "Year", "Actual Time", "No DC Exp.", "DC Exposed", "Difference", "Rel. Diff %"))
cat(paste(rep("-", 100), collapse = ""), "\n")

for (i in 1:nrow(detailed_output)) {
  row <- detailed_output[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-6d | %-12.2f | %-12.6f | %-12.6f | %+12.6f | %+12.2f%%\n",
              row$Year, 
              row$Actual_Time,
              row$No_DC,
              row$DC_Exposed,
              row$Difference,
              row$Rel_Diff_Pct))
}

cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 100), collapse = ""), "\n\n")

# Save annual survival probabilities
write.csv(detailed_output, 
          file.path(path_tables, "sup_table06_survival_probabilities_source.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

```
```{r main_fig3c_scale_period_models}
# ============================================================
# Larger vs other data centers, three periods, 25 km
# Periods: Pre-2016, 2016-2019, 2020-2024
# Full-sample Cox model
# Plot: 95% CI only
# ============================================================

library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(gtable)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Create three-period variables
# -----------------------------

larger_pre2016_vars <- c(
  "ai_larger_25km_before06",
  "ai_larger_25km_06_15"
)

other_pre2016_vars <- c(
  "ai_otherdc_25km_before06",
  "ai_otherdc_25km_06_15"
)

analysis_vars_needed <- c(
  larger_pre2016_vars,
  other_pre2016_vars,
  "ai_larger_25km_16_19",
  "ai_larger_25km_20_24",
  "ai_otherdc_25km_16_19",
  "ai_otherdc_25km_20_24"
)

control_vars <- c(
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct",
  "Alpha_3_code",
  "GEM_unit_phase_ID",
  "time0",
  "time1",
  "retire"
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(c(analysis_vars_needed, control_vars), names(data))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing variables:", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")))
}

data_large_other_3period <- data %>%
  mutate(
    ai_larger_25km_pre2016 = rowSums(across(all_of(larger_pre2016_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
    ai_otherdc_25km_pre2016 = rowSums(across(all_of(other_pre2016_vars)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

analysis_vars <- c(
  "ai_larger_25km_pre2016",
  "ai_larger_25km_16_19",
  "ai_larger_25km_20_24",
  "ai_otherdc_25km_pre2016",
  "ai_otherdc_25km_16_19",
  "ai_otherdc_25km_20_24"
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Run Cox model
# -----------------------------

formula_str <- paste0(
  "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
  paste(analysis_vars, collapse = " + "),
  " + Capacity_MW",
  " + Start_year",
  " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  " + rGDP_pc",
  " + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  " + td_loss_pct_output",
  " + demand_yoy_pct",
  " + renew_gen_share_pct",
  " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
)

cox_large_other_3period <- coxph(
  as.formula(formula_str),
  data = data_large_other_3period,
  cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
  ties = "efron",
  control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
)

summary(cox_large_other_3period)

# -----------------------------
# 3. Extract results
# -----------------------------

coef_summary <- summary(cox_large_other_3period)$coefficients
has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)

var_info <- data.frame(
  Variable = analysis_vars,
  DC_type = c(
    "Larger data centers",
    "Larger data centers",
    "Larger data centers",
    "Other data centers",
    "Other data centers",
    "Other data centers"
  ),
  Period = c(
    "Pre-2016",
    "2016-2019",
    "2020-2024",
    "Pre-2016",
    "2016-2019",
    "2020-2024"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

results_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(var_info))) {

  var_name <- var_info$Variable[i]

  if (!(var_name %in% rownames(coef_summary))) {
    cat(sprintf("Variable not estimated: %s\n", var_name))
    next
  }

  coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
  se <- if (has_robust) coef_summary[var_name, "robust se"] else coef_summary[var_name, "se(coef)"]
  pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]

  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Variable = var_name,
    DC_type = var_info$DC_type[i],
    Period = var_info$Period[i],
    Coefficient = coef_val,
    SE = se,
    HR = exp(coef_val),
    CI_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se),
    CI_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se),
    P_value = pval,
    Sig = case_when(
      pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
      pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
      pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    N_obs = cox_large_other_3period$n,
    N_events = cox_large_other_3period$nevent,
    Nonzero_exposure_n = sum(data_large_other_3period[[var_name]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    Exposed_events = sum(
      data_large_other_3period$retire == 1 &
        data_large_other_3period[[var_name]] > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
}

large_other_3period_results <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Period = factor(Period, levels = c("Pre-2016", "2016-2019", "2020-2024")),
    DC_type = factor(DC_type, levels = c("Larger data centers", "Other data centers")),
    label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Period, DC_type)

saveRDS(
  large_other_3period_results,
  file.path(path_temp, "main_fig3c_scale_period_results.rds")
)

write.csv(
  large_other_3period_results,
  file.path(path_tables, "main_fig3c_scale_period_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(large_other_3period_results %>%
        select(
          DC_type, Period, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper,
          P_value, Sig, Nonzero_exposure_n, Exposed_events
        ))

# -----------------------------
# 4. Plot: Fig. 3a-consistent style
# -----------------------------

FONT_FAMILY <- "sans"
FONT_SIZE_BASE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT <- 9
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_LEGEND <- 9

LINE_WIDTH_AXIS <- 0.5
LINE_WIDTH_ERROR <- 0.8
POINT_SIZE <- 1.8
POINT_STROKE <- 1.0

FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH <- unit(1.0, "cm")
FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH <- unit(1.6, "cm")

type_colors <- c(
  "Larger data centers" = "#FF4500",
  "Other data centers" = "#4169E1"
)

type_offsets <- c(
  "Larger data centers" = -0.15,
  "Other data centers" = 0.15
)

theme_nature_standard <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(t = 4)
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT,
        color = "black",
        margin = margin(r = 4)
      ),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE,
        margin = margin(t = 8)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_LEGEND),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 40, 12, 10)
    )
}

period_levels_bottom_to_top <- c("2020-2024", "2016-2019", "Pre-2016")

plot_data <- large_other_3period_results %>%
  mutate(
    Period = factor(as.character(Period), levels = period_levels_bottom_to_top),
    DC_type = factor(as.character(DC_type), levels = c("Larger data centers", "Other data centers")),
    y_base = as.numeric(Period),
    y_pos = y_base + unname(type_offsets[as.character(DC_type)])
  )

x_min <- min(plot_data$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(plot_data$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range <- x_max - x_min

x_limit_min <- max(0.05, x_min - 0.08 * x_range)
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.30 * x_range

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    HR_plot = pmin(pmax(HR, x_limit_min), x_limit_max),
    CI_lower_plot = pmax(CI_lower, x_limit_min),
    CI_upper_plot = pmin(CI_upper, x_limit_max),
    label_x = pmin(
      CI_upper_plot + 0.035 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min),
      x_limit_max - 0.02 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min)
    )
  )

forest_large_other_3period <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(color = DC_type)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = CI_lower_plot,
      xend = CI_upper_plot,
      y = y_pos,
      yend = y_pos
    ),
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = HR_plot, y = y_pos),
    shape = 21,
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, y = y_pos, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.35,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(period_levels_bottom_to_top),
    labels = period_levels_bottom_to_top,
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.45, 0.45))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max),
    breaks = pretty(c(x_limit_min, x_max), n = 5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)"
  ) +
  theme_nature_standard()

plot_grob <- ggplotGrob(forest_large_other_3period)
plot_grob$widths[2] <- FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH
plot_grob$widths[3] <- FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_figures, "main_fig3c_scale_period.pdf"),
  plot = plot_grob,
  width = 5.5,
  height = 3.6,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_figures, "main_fig3c_scale_period.tif"),
  plot = plot_grob,
  width = 5.5,
  height = 3.6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

print(forest_large_other_3period)
```

```{r sup_fig09_pooled_period_models}
# ============================================================
# All vs larger vs other data centers, no period split, 25 km
# Exposure = sum of four period-specific DCE variables
# Models:
#   1. All DC total exposure
#   2. Larger DC total + other DC total exposure
# Plot: 95% CI only
# ============================================================

library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(gtable)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Create no-period exposure variables
# -----------------------------

types <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

all_dc_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_25km_", types)
larger_dc_vars <- paste0("ai_larger_25km_", types)
other_dc_vars <- paste0("ai_otherdc_25km_", types)

needed_vars <- c(
  all_dc_vars,
  larger_dc_vars,
  other_dc_vars,
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct",
  "Alpha_3_code",
  "GEM_unit_phase_ID",
  "time0",
  "time1",
  "retire"
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(needed_vars, names(data))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing variables:", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")))
}

data_large_other_total <- data %>%
  mutate(
    ai_all_25km_total = rowSums(across(all_of(all_dc_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
    ai_larger_25km_total = rowSums(across(all_of(larger_dc_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
    ai_otherdc_25km_total = rowSums(across(all_of(other_dc_vars)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 2. Run Cox models
# -----------------------------

controls_formula <- paste0(
  " + Capacity_MW",
  " + Start_year",
  " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  " + rGDP_pc",
  " + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  " + td_loss_pct_output",
  " + demand_yoy_pct",
  " + renew_gen_share_pct",
  " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
)

formula_all <- paste0(
  "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
  "ai_all_25km_total",
  controls_formula
)

formula_large_other <- paste0(
  "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
  "ai_larger_25km_total + ai_otherdc_25km_total",
  controls_formula
)

cox_all_total <- coxph(
  as.formula(formula_all),
  data = data_large_other_total,
  cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
  ties = "efron",
  control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
)

cox_large_other_total <- coxph(
  as.formula(formula_large_other),
  data = data_large_other_total,
  cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
  ties = "efron",
  control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
)

summary(cox_all_total)
summary(cox_large_other_total)

# -----------------------------
# 3. Extract results
# -----------------------------

extract_one_coef <- function(model, var_name, label, model_label) {
  
  coef_summary <- summary(model)$coefficients
  has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
  
  if (!(var_name %in% rownames(coef_summary))) {
    stop(paste("Variable not estimated:", var_name))
  }
  
  coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
  se <- if (has_robust) coef_summary[var_name, "robust se"] else coef_summary[var_name, "se(coef)"]
  pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  data.frame(
    Measure = label,
    Model = model_label,
    Variable = var_name,
    Coefficient = coef_val,
    SE = se,
    HR = exp(coef_val),
    CI_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se),
    CI_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se),
    P_value = pval,
    Sig = case_when(
      pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
      pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
      pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    N_obs = model$n,
    N_events = model$nevent,
    Nonzero_exposure_n = sum(data_large_other_total[[var_name]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    Exposed_events = sum(
      data_large_other_total$retire == 1 &
        data_large_other_total[[var_name]] > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
}

total_dc_results <- bind_rows(
  extract_one_coef(
    cox_all_total,
    "ai_all_25km_total",
    "All data centers",
    "All DC model"
  ),
  extract_one_coef(
    cox_large_other_total,
    "ai_larger_25km_total",
    "Larger data centers",
    "Larger + other model"
  ),
  extract_one_coef(
    cox_large_other_total,
    "ai_otherdc_25km_total",
    "Other data centers",
    "Larger + other model"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = factor(
      Measure,
      levels = c("All data centers", "Larger data centers", "Other data centers")
    ),
    label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Measure)

saveRDS(
  total_dc_results,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig09_pooled_period_results.rds")
)

write.csv(
  total_dc_results,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig09_pooled_period_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    all_dc_model = list(model = cox_all_total, formula = formula_all),
    larger_other_model = list(model = cox_large_other_total, formula = formula_large_other)
  ),
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig09_pooled_period_models.rds")
)

print(total_dc_results %>%
        select(
          Measure, Model, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper,
          P_value, Sig, Nonzero_exposure_n, Exposed_events,
          N_obs, N_events
        ))

# -----------------------------
# 4. Plot: Fig. 3a-consistent style
# -----------------------------

forest_all_larger_other_total <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(color = Measure)) +
```

```{r sup_fig11a_cutoff_models}
# ============================================================
# Sensitivity 2: Temporal cutoff for larger vs other, 25 km
# Focal recent-period windows:
#   2018-2024, 2019-2024, 2020-2024, 2021-2024, 2022-2024
# Baseline larger/other classification
# Plot focuses on focal recent-period coefficient
# ============================================================

library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(gtable)

cutoff_specs <- list(
  "cut18" = list(
    Label = "2018-2024",
    Larger_prefix = "ai_larger_cut18",
    Other_prefix = "ai_otherdc_cut18",
    Pre_vars_larger = c("ai_larger_cut18_25km_before06", "ai_larger_cut18_25km_06_15"),
    Pre_vars_other = c("ai_otherdc_cut18_25km_before06", "ai_otherdc_cut18_25km_06_15"),
    Mid_larger = "ai_larger_cut18_25km_16_17",
    Mid_other = "ai_otherdc_cut18_25km_16_17",
    Focal_larger = "ai_larger_cut18_25km_18_24",
    Focal_other = "ai_otherdc_cut18_25km_18_24"
  ),
  "cut19" = list(
    Label = "2019-2024",
    Larger_prefix = "ai_larger_cut19",
    Other_prefix = "ai_otherdc_cut19",
    Pre_vars_larger = c("ai_larger_cut19_25km_before06", "ai_larger_cut19_25km_06_15"),
    Pre_vars_other = c("ai_otherdc_cut19_25km_before06", "ai_otherdc_cut19_25km_06_15"),
    Mid_larger = "ai_larger_cut19_25km_16_18",
    Mid_other = "ai_otherdc_cut19_25km_16_18",
    Focal_larger = "ai_larger_cut19_25km_19_24",
    Focal_other = "ai_otherdc_cut19_25km_19_24"
  ),
  "cut20" = list(
    Label = "2020-2024",
    Larger_prefix = "ai_larger",
    Other_prefix = "ai_otherdc",
    Pre_vars_larger = c("ai_larger_25km_before06", "ai_larger_25km_06_15"),
    Pre_vars_other = c("ai_otherdc_25km_before06", "ai_otherdc_25km_06_15"),
    Mid_larger = "ai_larger_25km_16_19",
    Mid_other = "ai_otherdc_25km_16_19",
    Focal_larger = "ai_larger_25km_20_24",
    Focal_other = "ai_otherdc_25km_20_24"
  ),
  "cut21" = list(
    Label = "2021-2024",
    Larger_prefix = "ai_larger_cut21",
    Other_prefix = "ai_otherdc_cut21",
    Pre_vars_larger = c("ai_larger_cut21_25km_before06", "ai_larger_cut21_25km_06_15"),
    Pre_vars_other = c("ai_otherdc_cut21_25km_before06", "ai_otherdc_cut21_25km_06_15"),
    Mid_larger = "ai_larger_cut21_25km_16_20",
    Mid_other = "ai_otherdc_cut21_25km_16_20",
    Focal_larger = "ai_larger_cut21_25km_21_24",
    Focal_other = "ai_otherdc_cut21_25km_21_24"
  ),
  "cut22" = list(
    Label = "2022-2024",
    Larger_prefix = "ai_larger_cut22",
    Other_prefix = "ai_otherdc_cut22",
    Pre_vars_larger = c("ai_larger_cut22_25km_before06", "ai_larger_cut22_25km_06_15"),
    Pre_vars_other = c("ai_otherdc_cut22_25km_before06", "ai_otherdc_cut22_25km_06_15"),
    Mid_larger = "ai_larger_cut22_25km_16_21",
    Mid_other = "ai_otherdc_cut22_25km_16_21",
    Focal_larger = "ai_larger_cut22_25km_22_24",
    Focal_other = "ai_otherdc_cut22_25km_22_24"
  )
)

control_vars <- c(
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct",
  "Alpha_3_code",
  "GEM_unit_phase_ID",
  "time0",
  "time1",
  "retire"
)

run_cutoff_model <- function(spec_id, spec) {
  
  larger_pre_var <- paste0(spec$Larger_prefix, "_25km_pre2016")
  other_pre_var <- paste0(spec$Other_prefix, "_25km_pre2016")
  
  needed_vars <- c(
    spec$Pre_vars_larger,
    spec$Pre_vars_other,
    spec$Mid_larger,
    spec$Mid_other,
    spec$Focal_larger,
    spec$Focal_other,
    control_vars
  )
  
  missing_vars <- setdiff(needed_vars, names(data))
  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Missing variables for cutoff %s: %s",
      spec$Label,
      paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
  
  data_model <- data %>%
    mutate(
      !!larger_pre_var := rowSums(across(all_of(spec$Pre_vars_larger)), na.rm = TRUE),
      !!other_pre_var := rowSums(across(all_of(spec$Pre_vars_other)), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  analysis_vars <- c(
    larger_pre_var,
    spec$Mid_larger,
    spec$Focal_larger,
    other_pre_var,
    spec$Mid_other,
    spec$Focal_other
  )
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(analysis_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year",
    " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
    " + td_loss_pct_output",
    " + demand_yoy_pct",
    " + renew_gen_share_pct",
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  fit <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = data_model,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )
  
  coef_summary <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
  
  var_info <- data.frame(
    Variable = analysis_vars,
    DC_type = c(
      "Larger data centers",
      "Larger data centers",
      "Larger data centers",
      "Other data centers",
      "Other data centers",
      "Other data centers"
    ),
    Period_role = c(
      "Pre-2016",
      "Intermediate",
      "Focal recent period",
      "Pre-2016",
      "Intermediate",
      "Focal recent period"
    ),
    Focal = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  rows <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(var_info))) {
    var_name <- var_info$Variable[i]
    
    if (!(var_name %in% rownames(coef_summary))) {
      cat(sprintf("Variable not estimated: %s\n", var_name))
      next
    }
    
    coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
    se <- if (has_robust) coef_summary[var_name, "robust se"] else coef_summary[var_name, "se(coef)"]
    pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Sensitivity = "Temporal cutoff",
      Spec_id = spec_id,
      Cutoff_window = spec$Label,
      Variable = var_name,
      DC_type = var_info$DC_type[i],
      Period_role = var_info$Period_role[i],
      Focal = var_info$Focal[i],
      Coefficient = coef_val,
      SE = se,
      HR = exp(coef_val),
      CI_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se),
      CI_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se),
      P_value = pval,
      Sig = case_when(
        pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
        pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
        pval < 0.10 ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      N_obs = fit$n,
      N_events = fit$nevent,
      Nonzero_exposure_n = sum(data_model[[var_name]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      Exposed_events = sum(
        data_model$retire == 1 &
          data_model[[var_name]] > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Formula = formula_str
    )
  }
  
  bind_rows(rows)
}

cutoff_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(cutoff_specs), function(spec_id) {
    cat(sprintf("\nRunning cutoff sensitivity: %s\n", cutoff_specs[[spec_id]]$Label))
    run_cutoff_model(spec_id, cutoff_specs[[spec_id]])
  })
) %>%
  mutate(
    Cutoff_window = factor(
      Cutoff_window,
      levels = sapply(cutoff_specs, function(x) x$Label)
    ),
    DC_type = factor(DC_type, levels = c("Larger data centers", "Other data centers")),
    label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Cutoff_window, DC_type, Period_role)

cutoff_focal_results <- cutoff_results %>%
  filter(Focal)

saveRDS(
  cutoff_results,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig11_cutoff_all_results.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  cutoff_focal_results,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig11_cutoff_focal_results.rds")
)

write.csv(
  cutoff_results,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig11_cutoff_all_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  cutoff_focal_results,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig11_cutoff_focal_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(cutoff_focal_results %>%
        select(
          Cutoff_window, DC_type, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper,
          P_value, Sig, Nonzero_exposure_n, Exposed_events, N_obs, N_events
        ))
```

```{r sup_fig11a_cutoff_plot}
# ============================================================
# Compact plot a: cutoff sensitivity
# ============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)

type_colors <- c(
  "Larger data centers" = "#9E1C60",
  "Other data centers"  = "#4169E1"
)

type_offsets <- c(
  "Larger data centers" = -0.13,
  "Other data centers"  =  0.13
)

cutoff_levels_bottom_to_top <- rev(
  sapply(cutoff_specs, function(x) x$Label)
)

plot_data_cutoff <- cutoff_focal_results %>%
  mutate(
    Cutoff_window = factor(
      as.character(Cutoff_window),
      levels = cutoff_levels_bottom_to_top
    ),
    DC_type = factor(
      DC_type,
      levels = c(
        "Larger data centers",
        "Other data centers"
      )
    ),
    y_base = as.numeric(Cutoff_window),
    y_pos = y_base + unname(
      type_offsets[as.character(DC_type)]
    )
  )

x_min <- min(plot_data_cutoff$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(plot_data_cutoff$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range <- x_max - x_min

if (!is.finite(x_range) || x_range == 0) {
  x_range <- 0.1
}

x_limit_min <- max(0.05, x_min - 0.06 * x_range)
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.22 * x_range

plot_data_cutoff <- plot_data_cutoff %>%
  mutate(
    CI_lower_plot = pmax(CI_lower, x_limit_min),
    CI_upper_plot = pmin(CI_upper, x_limit_max),
    label_x = pmin(
      CI_upper_plot + 0.018 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min),
      x_limit_max - 0.018 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min)
    )
  )

theme_compact <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 8.5, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7.2, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = 8.2,
        margin = margin(t = 5)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.45
      ),
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.45
      ),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(1.8, "pt"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.32, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.08, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 22, 2, 4)
    )
}

forest_cutoff_sens <- ggplot(
  plot_data_cutoff,
  aes(color = DC_type)
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = CI_lower_plot,
```

```{r sup_fig11b_timing_models}
# ============================================================
# Timing test:
# Compare DCE commissioned in 2018-2019 versus 2020-2022
#
# Model 1: All data centers
# Model 2: Larger and other data centers
# ============================================================

library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Construct combined exposure periods
# ------------------------------------------------------------

data_timing <- data %>%
  mutate(
    # All data centers
    ai_all_18_19 =
      ai_annual_25km_2018 +
      ai_annual_25km_2019,

    ai_all_20_22 =
      ai_annual_25km_2020 +
      ai_annual_25km_2021 +
      ai_annual_25km_2022,

    # Larger data centers
    ai_larger_18_19 =
      ai_lgann_25km_2018 +
      ai_lgann_25km_2019,

    ai_larger_20_22 =
      ai_lgann_25km_2020 +
      ai_lgann_25km_2021 +
      ai_lgann_25km_2022,

    # Other data centers
    ai_other_18_19 =
      ai_otann_25km_2018 +
      ai_otann_25km_2019,

    ai_other_20_22 =
      ai_otann_25km_2020 +
      ai_otann_25km_2021 +
      ai_otann_25km_2022
  )

controls <- c(
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Model 1: All data centers
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_exposure_vars <- c(
  "ai_annual_25km_before06",
  "ai_annual_25km_06_15",
  "ai_annual_25km_16_17",
  "ai_all_18_19",
  "ai_all_20_22",
  "ai_annual_25km_23_24"
)

formula_all <- as.formula(
  paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(all_exposure_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " + ",
    paste(controls, collapse = " + "),
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
)

model_all <- coxph(
  formula_all,
  data = data_timing,
  cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
  ties = "efron",
  control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Model 2: Larger versus other data centers
# ------------------------------------------------------------

larger_exposure_vars <- c(
  "ai_lgann_25km_before06",
  "ai_lgann_25km_06_15",
  "ai_lgann_25km_16_17",
  "ai_larger_18_19",
  "ai_larger_20_22",
  "ai_lgann_25km_23_24"
)

other_exposure_vars <- c(
  "ai_otann_25km_before06",
  "ai_otann_25km_06_15",
  "ai_otann_25km_16_17",
  "ai_other_18_19",
  "ai_other_20_22",
  "ai_otann_25km_23_24"
)

split_exposure_vars <- c(
  larger_exposure_vars,
  other_exposure_vars
)

formula_split <- as.formula(
  paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(split_exposure_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " + ",
    paste(controls, collapse = " + "),
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
)

model_split <- coxph(
  formula_split,
  data = data_timing,
  cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
  ties = "efron",
  control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract coefficient results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_cox_results <- function(model, variable_info) {

  coef_table <- summary(model)$coefficients
  robust_se <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_table)

  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(variable_info)), function(i) {

    variable <- variable_info$Variable[i]

    if (!variable %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    beta <- coef_table[variable, "coef"]

    se <- if (robust_se) {
      coef_table[variable, "robust se"]
    } else {
      coef_table[variable, "se(coef)"]
    }

    p_value <- coef_table[variable, "Pr(>|z|)"]

    data.frame(
      Model = variable_info$Model[i],
      DC_type = variable_info$DC_type[i],
      Period = variable_info$Period[i],
      Variable = variable,
      Coefficient = beta,
      SE = se,
      HR = exp(beta),
      CI_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
      CI_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * se),
      P_value = p_value,
      Sig = case_when(
        p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_value < 0.10  ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      N_obs = model$n,
      N_events = model$nevent
    )
  }))
}

all_info <- data.frame(
  Model = "All data centers",
  DC_type = "All data centers",
  Period = c(
    "Before 2006", "2006-2015", "2016-2017",
    "2018-2019", "2020-2022", "2023-2024"
  ),
  Variable = all_exposure_vars
)

split_info <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(
    Model = "Larger versus other",
    DC_type = "Larger data centers",
    Period = c(
      "Before 2006", "2006-2015", "2016-2017",
      "2018-2019", "2020-2022", "2023-2024"
    ),
    Variable = larger_exposure_vars
  ),
  data.frame(
    Model = "Larger versus other",
    DC_type = "Other data centers",
    Period = c(
      "Before 2006", "2006-2015", "2016-2017",
      "2018-2019", "2020-2022", "2023-2024"
    ),
    Variable = other_exposure_vars
  )
)

results_all <- extract_cox_results(model_all, all_info)
results_split <- extract_cox_results(model_split, split_info)

timing_results <- bind_rows(
  results_all,
  results_split
) %>%
  mutate(
    Label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig)
  )

# Focal results
focal_results <- timing_results %>%
  filter(Period %in% c("2018-2019", "2020-2022"))

print(
  focal_results %>%
    select(
      Model, DC_type, Period,
      HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Wald coefficient-difference tests
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wald_difference <- function(model, variable_1, variable_2, label) {

  beta <- coef(model)
  variance <- vcov(model)

  difference <- beta[variable_1] - beta[variable_2]

  difference_se <- sqrt(
    variance[variable_1, variable_1] +
    variance[variable_2, variable_2] -
    2 * variance[variable_1, variable_2]
  )

  z_value <- difference / difference_se
  p_value <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_value))

  data.frame(
    Test = label,
    Variable_1 = variable_1,
    Variable_2 = variable_2,
    Coefficient_difference = unname(difference),
    SE = unname(difference_se),
    Z = unname(z_value),
    P_value = unname(p_value)
  )
}

wald_results <- bind_rows(
  wald_difference(
    model_all,
    "ai_all_20_22",
    "ai_all_18_19",
    "All DCs: 2020-2022 versus 2018-2019"
  ),
  wald_difference(
    model_split,
    "ai_larger_20_22",
    "ai_larger_18_19",
    "Larger DCs: 2020-2022 versus 2018-2019"
  ),
  wald_difference(
    model_split,
    "ai_other_20_22",
    "ai_other_18_19",
    "Other DCs: 2020-2022 versus 2018-2019"
  ),
  wald_difference(
    model_split,
    "ai_larger_20_22",
    "ai_other_20_22",
    "2020-2022: larger versus other DCs"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Sig = case_when(
      P_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      P_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      P_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      P_value < 0.10  ~ "+",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

print(wald_results)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Save results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  model_all,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig11b_timing_all_model.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  model_split,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig11b_timing_large_other_model.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  focal_results,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig11b_timing_results.rds")
)

write.csv(
  timing_results,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig11b_timing_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  wald_results,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig11b_timing_wald_tests.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r sup_fig11b_timing_plot}
# ============================================================
# Compact plot b: timing-period comparison with Wald tests

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)

type_colors <- c(
  "All data centers" = "#FF4500",
  "Larger data centers" = "#9E1C60",
  "Other data centers" = "#4169E1"
)

type_offsets <- c(
  "All data centers" = 0,
  "Larger data centers" = -0.12,
  "Other data centers" = 0.12
)

period_levels <- c("2020-2022", "2018-2019")

plot_data_timing <- focal_results %>%
  mutate(
    Panel = if_else(
      Model == "All data centers",
      "All data centers",
      "Larger versus other"
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      Panel,
      levels = c("All data centers", "Larger versus other")
    ),
    Period = factor(Period, levels = period_levels),
    DC_type = factor(
      DC_type,
      levels = c(
        "All data centers",
        "Larger data centers",
        "Other data centers"
      )
    ),
    y_base = as.numeric(Period),
    y_pos = y_base + unname(type_offsets[as.character(DC_type)]),
    label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig)
  )

x_min <- min(plot_data_timing$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(plot_data_timing$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range <- x_max - x_min

if (!is.finite(x_range) || x_range == 0) x_range <- 0.1

x_limit_min <- max(0.05, x_min - 0.06 * x_range)
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.50 * x_range

# Wald tests comparing 2020-2022 with 2018-2019
wald_plot <- wald_results %>%
  filter(Test %in% c(
    "All DCs: 2020-2022 versus 2018-2019",
    "Larger DCs: 2020-2022 versus 2018-2019",
    "Other DCs: 2020-2022 versus 2018-2019"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    Panel = if_else(
      grepl("^All DCs", Test),
      "All data centers",
      "Larger versus other"
    ),
    DC_type = case_when(
      grepl("^All DCs", Test) ~ "All data centers",
      grepl("^Larger DCs", Test) ~ "Larger data centers",
      TRUE ~ "Other data centers"
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      Panel,
      levels = c("All data centers", "Larger versus other")
    ),
    y_post = 1 + unname(type_offsets[DC_type]),
    y_pre = 2 + unname(type_offsets[DC_type]),
    x_bracket = case_when(
      DC_type == "All data centers" ~ x_max + 0.25 * x_range,
      DC_type == "Larger data centers" ~ x_max + 0.18 * x_range,
      TRUE ~ x_max + 0.36 * x_range
    ),
    bracket_label = if_else(Sig == "" | is.na(Sig), "ns", Sig)
  )

cap_width <- 0.025 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min)

plot_data_timing <- plot_data_timing %>%
  mutate(
    CI_lower_plot = pmax(CI_lower, x_limit_min),
    CI_upper_plot = pmin(CI_upper, x_limit_max),
    label_x = pmin(
      CI_upper_plot + 0.012 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min),
      x_max + 0.10 * x_range
    )
  )

forest_timing <- ggplot(plot_data_timing, aes(color = DC_type)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = CI_lower_plot,
      xend = CI_upper_plot,
      y = y_pos,
      yend = y_pos
    ),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = HR, y = y_pos),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.55,
    stroke = 0.85,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, y = y_pos, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2.25,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Vertical Wald brackets
  geom_segment(
    data = wald_plot,
    aes(
      x = x_bracket,
      xend = x_bracket,
      y = y_post,
      yend = y_pre
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = wald_plot,
    aes(
      x = x_bracket - cap_width,
      xend = x_bracket,
      y = y_post,
      yend = y_post
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = wald_plot,
    aes(
      x = x_bracket - cap_width,
      xend = x_bracket,
      y = y_pre,
      yend = y_pre
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = wald_plot,
    aes(
      x = x_bracket + 0.012 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min),
      y = (y_post + y_pre) / 2,
      label = bracket_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2.4,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Panel, ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = type_colors,
    labels = c("All", "Larger", "Other")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(period_levels),
    labels = period_levels,
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.30, 0.30))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max),
    breaks = pretty(c(x_limit_min, x_max), n = 4),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)") +
  theme_compact() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 7.5,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 2)
    ),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.15, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        fill = "white",
        size = 1.8
      )
    )
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(path_figures, "sup_fig11b_timing_comparison.pdf"),
  forest_timing,
  width = 3.35,
  height = 3.45,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf",
  family = "sans",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

print(forest_timing)
```

```{r sup_fig12_larger_definition_models}
# ============================================================
# Sensitivity: Larger vs other classification, 25 km
# Two periods:
#   1. Pre-2020 = before06 + 06_15 + 16_19
#   2. 2020-2024
# Classifications:
#   1. Baseline larger: hyperscale + cloud + wholesale + crypto
#   2. Crypto as other
#   3. Crypto + wholesale as other
# ============================================================

library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(gtable)

classification_specs <- list(
  "baseline" = list(
    Label = "Baseline larger definition",
    Larger_prefix = "ai_larger",
    Other_prefix = "ai_otherdc",
    Note = "Hyperscale, cloud, wholesale, and crypto mining as larger"
  ),
  "crypto_other" = list(
    Label = "Crypto mining as other",
    Larger_prefix = "ai_largenc",
    Other_prefix = "ai_othernc",
    Note = "Crypto mining moved to other"
  ),
  "strict_larger" = list(
    Label = "Only hyperscale/cloud as larger",
    Larger_prefix = "ai_largest",
    Other_prefix = "ai_otherst",
    Note = "Crypto mining and wholesale moved to other"
  )
)

control_vars <- c(
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct",
  "Alpha_3_code",
  "GEM_unit_phase_ID",
  "time0",
  "time1",
  "retire"
)

run_classification_pre2020_model <- function(spec_id, spec) {
  
  larger_prefix <- spec$Larger_prefix
  other_prefix <- spec$Other_prefix
  
  larger_pre2020_vars <- paste0(
    larger_prefix,
    "_25km_",
    c("before06", "06_15", "16_19")
  )
  
  other_pre2020_vars <- paste0(
    other_prefix,
    "_25km_",
    c("before06", "06_15", "16_19")
  )
  
  larger_pre_var <- paste0(larger_prefix, "_25km_pre2020")
  other_pre_var <- paste0(other_prefix, "_25km_pre2020")
  
  larger_2020_var <- paste0(larger_prefix, "_25km_20_24")
  other_2020_var <- paste0(other_prefix, "_25km_20_24")
  
  needed_vars <- c(
    larger_pre2020_vars,
    other_pre2020_vars,
    larger_2020_var,
    other_2020_var,
    control_vars
  )
  
  missing_vars <- setdiff(needed_vars, names(data))
  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Missing variables for %s: %s",
      spec$Label,
      paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
  
  data_model <- data %>%
    mutate(
      !!larger_pre_var := rowSums(across(all_of(larger_pre2020_vars)), na.rm = TRUE),
      !!other_pre_var := rowSums(across(all_of(other_pre2020_vars)), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  analysis_vars <- c(
    larger_pre_var,
    larger_2020_var,
    other_pre_var,
    other_2020_var
  )
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(analysis_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year",
    " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
    " + td_loss_pct_output",
    " + demand_yoy_pct",
    " + renew_gen_share_pct",
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  fit <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = data_model,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )
  
  coef_summary <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)

  # Two-sided Wald test of equality between the larger-data-center
  # coefficients for 2020-2024 and pre-2020. vcov(fit) returns the
  # cluster-robust covariance matrix when coxph() uses cluster().
  variance_matrix <- vcov(fit)
  larger_difference <-
    unname(coef(fit)[larger_2020_var]) -
    unname(coef(fit)[larger_pre_var])

  larger_difference_variance <-
    variance_matrix[larger_2020_var, larger_2020_var] +
    variance_matrix[larger_pre_var, larger_pre_var] -
    2 * variance_matrix[larger_2020_var, larger_pre_var]

  larger_difference_se <- sqrt(larger_difference_variance)
  larger_wald_z <- larger_difference / larger_difference_se
  larger_wald_chisq <- larger_wald_z^2
  larger_wald_p <- pchisq(
    larger_wald_chisq,
    df = 1,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  wald_result <- data.frame(
    Spec_id = spec_id,
    Classification = spec$Label,
    Classification_note = spec$Note,
    Contrast = "Larger: 2020-2024 vs Pre-2020",
    Coefficient_difference = larger_difference,
    Difference_SE = larger_difference_se,
    HR_ratio = exp(larger_difference),
    Wald_z = larger_wald_z,
    Wald_chisq = larger_wald_chisq,
    P_value = larger_wald_p,
    Sig = case_when(
      larger_wald_p < 0.001 ~ "***",
      larger_wald_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
      larger_wald_p < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    N_obs = fit$n,
    N_events = fit$nevent,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  var_info <- data.frame(
    Variable = analysis_vars,
    DC_type = c(
      "Larger data centers",
      "Larger data centers",
      "Other data centers",
      "Other data centers"
    ),
    Period = c(
      "Pre-2020",
      "2020-2024",
      "Pre-2020",
      "2020-2024"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  rows <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(var_info))) {
    var_name <- var_info$Variable[i]
    
    if (!(var_name %in% rownames(coef_summary))) {
      cat(sprintf("Variable not estimated: %s\n", var_name))
      next
    }
    
    coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
    se <- if (has_robust) coef_summary[var_name, "robust se"] else coef_summary[var_name, "se(coef)"]
    pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Sensitivity = "Classification, pre-2020 combined",
      Spec_id = spec_id,
      Classification = spec$Label,
      Classification_note = spec$Note,
      Variable = var_name,
      DC_type = var_info$DC_type[i],
      Period = var_info$Period[i],
      Coefficient = coef_val,
      SE = se,
      HR = exp(coef_val),
      CI_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se),
      CI_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se),
      P_value = pval,
      Sig = case_when(
        pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
        pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
        pval < 0.10 ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      N_obs = fit$n,
      N_events = fit$nevent,
      Nonzero_exposure_n = sum(data_model[[var_name]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      Exposed_events = sum(
        data_model$retire == 1 &
          data_model[[var_name]] > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Formula = formula_str
    )
  }
  
  list(
    results = bind_rows(rows),
    wald = wald_result
  )
}

classification_outputs <- lapply(
  names(classification_specs),
  function(spec_id) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "\nRunning classification sensitivity, pre-2020 combined: %s\n",
      classification_specs[[spec_id]]$Label
    ))
    run_classification_pre2020_model(
      spec_id,
      classification_specs[[spec_id]]
    )
  }
)

classification_pre2020_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(classification_outputs, `[[`, "results")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = factor(
      Classification,
      levels = sapply(classification_specs, function(x) x$Label)
    ),
    Period = factor(Period, levels = c("Pre-2020", "2020-2024")),
    DC_type = factor(
      DC_type,
      levels = c("Larger data centers", "Other data centers")
    ),
    label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Classification, Period, DC_type)

classification_wald_tests <- bind_rows(
  lapply(classification_outputs, `[[`, "wald")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = factor(
      Classification,
      levels = sapply(classification_specs, function(x) x$Label)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Classification)

saveRDS(
  classification_pre2020_results,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig12_larger_definition_results.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  classification_wald_tests,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig12_larger_definition_wald_tests.rds")
)

write.csv(
  classification_pre2020_results,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig12_larger_definition_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  classification_wald_tests,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig12_larger_definition_wald_tests.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(
  classification_pre2020_results %>%
    select(
      Classification, DC_type, Period, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper,
      P_value, Sig, Nonzero_exposure_n, Exposed_events, N_obs, N_events
    )
)

cat("\nWald tests: larger-data-center coefficient, 2020-2024 vs pre-2020\n")
print(classification_wald_tests)


```

```{r sup_fig12_larger_definition_plot}
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)

}

FONT_FAMILY <- "sans"
FONT_SIZE_BASE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT <- 8.5
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_LEGEND <- 8.5

LINE_WIDTH_AXIS <- 0.5
LINE_WIDTH_ERROR <- 0.8
POINT_SIZE <- 1.8
POINT_STROKE <- 1.0

type_colors <- c(
  "Larger data centers" = "#9E1C60",
  "Other data centers"  = "#4169E1"
)

type_offsets <- c(
  "Larger data centers" = -0.13,
  "Other data centers" = 0.13
)

theme_nature_sens <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE,
        margin = margin(t = 8)
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_LEGEND),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 34, 8, 8)
    )
}

period_levels_bottom_to_top <- c("2020-2024", "Pre-2020")

plot_data <- classification_pre2020_results %>%
  mutate(
    Period = factor(as.character(Period), levels = period_levels_bottom_to_top),
    DC_type = factor(
      as.character(DC_type),
      levels = c("Larger data centers", "Other data centers")
    ),
    y_base = as.numeric(Period),
    y_pos = y_base + unname(type_offsets[as.character(DC_type)])
  )

x_min <- min(plot_data$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(plot_data$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range <- x_max - x_min

if (!is.finite(x_range) || x_range == 0) {
  x_range <- 0.1
}

x_limit_min <- max(0.05, x_min - 0.08 * x_range)
x_limit_max <- x_max + 0.45 * x_range

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    HR_plot = pmin(pmax(HR, x_limit_min), x_limit_max),
    CI_lower_plot = pmax(CI_lower, x_limit_min),
    CI_upper_plot = pmin(CI_upper, x_limit_max),
    label_x = pmin(
      CI_upper_plot + 0.025 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min),
      x_limit_max - 0.02 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min)
    )
  )

# Brackets compare the two larger-data-center coefficients within
# each classification. Their labels are based on two-sided Wald tests.
bracket_x <- x_max + 0.24 * x_range
bracket_tick <- 0.035 * x_range
bracket_text_x <- bracket_x + 0.045 * x_range

bracket_data <- classification_wald_tests %>%
  transmute(
    Classification = factor(
      as.character(Classification),
      levels = sapply(classification_specs, function(x) x$Label)
    ),
    y_lower = 1 + unname(type_offsets["Larger data centers"]),
    y_upper = 2 + unname(type_offsets["Larger data centers"]),
    y_mid = (y_lower + y_upper) / 2,
    bracket_x = bracket_x,
    bracket_tick_x = bracket_x - bracket_tick,
    bracket_text_x = bracket_text_x,
    Wald_label = Sig
  )

forest_classification_pre2020 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(color = DC_type)) +
  geom_vline(

    color = "black",

  ) +
```
