```{r sup_fig12_larger_definition_plot}
    aes(
      x = CI_lower_plot,
      xend = CI_upper_plot,
      y = y_pos,
      yend = y_pos
    ),
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_ERROR,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = HR_plot, y = y_pos),
    shape = 21,
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, y = y_pos, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT * 0.33,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = bracket_data,
    aes(
      x = bracket_x,
      xend = bracket_x,
      y = y_lower,
      yend = y_upper
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = bracket_data,
    aes(
      x = bracket_tick_x,
      xend = bracket_x,
      y = y_lower,
      yend = y_lower
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = bracket_data,
    aes(
      x = bracket_tick_x,
      xend = bracket_x,
      y = y_upper,
      yend = y_upper
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = bracket_data,
    aes(
      x = bracket_text_x,
      y = y_mid,
      label = Wald_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    family = FONT_FAMILY
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Classification, ncol = 1) +

  scale_y_continuous(

  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(

    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)"
  ) +
  theme_nature_sens()

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_figures, "sup_fig12_larger_definition.pdf"),
  plot = forest_classification_pre2020,
  width = 6.2,
  height = 4.8,
  units = "in",

)
```

```{r sup_table12_schoenfeld_tests}
# ============================================================
# Test proportional-hazards assumptions for Supplementary Table 12
# Baseline 25 km Cox model
# ============================================================

library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# Load the baseline 25 km Cox model
model_key <- "25km"

if (!(model_key %in% names(cox_models_list))) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Model '%s' not found. Available model keys are: %s",
    model_key,
    paste(names(cox_models_list), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

cox_model <- cox_models_list[[model_key]]$model

# Test proportional-hazards assumptions
zph_test <- cox.zph(cox_model)

# Format test results
zph_df <- as.data.frame(zph_test$table)
zph_df$Variable <- rownames(zph_df)

# Add significance markers
zph_df$Status <- case_when(
  zph_df$p < 0.001 ~ "***",
  zph_df$p < 0.01 ~ "**",
  zph_df$p < 0.05 ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ ""
)

# Select and rename columns
si_table_schoenfeld <- zph_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Variable,
    `χ²` = chisq,
    `p-value` = p,
    Status
  )

# Print results
cat("--- Schoenfeld residual test ---\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(si_table_schoenfeld))) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "%s: χ² = %.2f, p = %.4f %s\n",
    si_table_schoenfeld$Variable[i],
    si_table_schoenfeld$`χ²`[i],
    si_table_schoenfeld$`p-value`[i],
    si_table_schoenfeld$Status[i]
  ))
}

# Global test
cat("\n--- Global Test ---\n")
global_row <- si_table_schoenfeld %>%
  filter(Variable == "GLOBAL")

if (nrow(global_row) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "GLOBAL: χ² = %.2f, p = %.4f %s\n",
    global_row$`χ²`,
    global_row$`p-value`,
    global_row$Status
  ))
}

# Save Supplementary Table 12 source data
write.csv(
  si_table_schoenfeld,
  file = file.path(path_tables, "sup_table12_schoenfeld_source.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nTable saved to:", file.path(path_tables, "sup_table12_schoenfeld_source.csv"), "\n")
cat("========================================\n")
```


```{r sup_table04_time_dependent_cox}

library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================
# Time-dependent Cox model for Supplementary Table 4
# Add time interactions for variables violating PH assumption
# based on Schoenfeld residual tests
# ============================================================

time_transform <- function(x, t, ...) {
  x * log(t + 1)
}

formula_tt <- as.formula(
  "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~
   ai_proximity_25km_before06 +
   ai_proximity_25km_06_15 +
   ai_proximity_25km_16_19 +
   ai_proximity_25km_20_24 + tt(ai_proximity_25km_20_24) +
   Capacity_MW + tt(Capacity_MW) +
   Start_year + tt(Start_year) +
   Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ +
   Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh + tt(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh) +
   rGDP_pc + tt(rGDP_pc) +
   elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw + tt(elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw) +
   td_loss_pct_output +
   demand_yoy_pct + tt(demand_yoy_pct) +
   renew_gen_share_pct + tt(renew_gen_share_pct) +
   strata(Alpha_3_code)"
)

cox_tt_model <- coxph(
  formula_tt,
  data = data,
  cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
  ties = "efron",
  tt = time_transform,
  control = coxph.control(iter.max = 300)
)

summary(cox_tt_model)

# -----------------------------
# Extract and format results
# -----------------------------

coef_summary <- summary(cox_tt_model)$coefficients
has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)

n_obs <- cox_tt_model$n
n_events <- cox_tt_model$nevent

vars_to_display <- c(
  "ai_proximity_25km_before06",
  "ai_proximity_25km_06_15",
  "ai_proximity_25km_16_19",
  "ai_proximity_25km_20_24",
  "tt(ai_proximity_25km_20_24)",
  "Capacity_MW",
  "tt(Capacity_MW)",
  "Start_year",
  "tt(Start_year)",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "tt(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh)",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "tt(rGDP_pc)",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "tt(elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw)",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "tt(demand_yoy_pct)",
  "renew_gen_share_pct",
  "tt(renew_gen_share_pct)"
)

results_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(coef_summary))) {
  
  var_name <- rownames(coef_summary)[i]
  
  if (!var_name %in% vars_to_display) next
  
  coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
  se <- if (has_robust) coef_summary[i, "robust se"] else coef_summary[i, "se(coef)"]
  pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Variable = var_name,
    Type = ifelse(grepl("^tt\\(", var_name), "Time Interaction", "Main Effect"),
    Coefficient = coef_val,
    HR = exp(coef_val),
    SE = se,
    CI_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se),
    CI_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se),
    P_value = pval,
    Sig = case_when(
      pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
      pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
      pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
      pval < 0.10 ~ "+",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    N_obs = n_obs,
    N_events = n_events
  )
}

results_df_tt <- bind_rows(results_list)

write.csv(
  results_df_tt,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_table04_time_dependent_cox_source.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(results_df_tt)
```

```{r sup_fig13_region_models}

# ============================================================
# Heterogeneity: China, United States, Europe and other regions
# 25 km specification; 2020-2024 DCE
# ============================================================

library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================
# 1. Define geographic groups
# ============================================================

region_source_col <- if ("Region_y" %in% names(data)) {
  "Region_y"
} else if ("Subregion" %in% names(data)) {
  "Subregion"
} else {
  stop("Neither Region_y nor Subregion is found in data.")
}

europe_subregions <- c(
  "Eastern Europe",
  "Northern Europe",
  "Southern Europe",
  "Western Europe"
)

region_order <- c(
  "Other regions",
  "China",
  "United States",
  "Europe"
)

plot_region_order <- c(
  "China",
  "United States",
  "Europe",
  "Other regions"
)

data_base <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Alpha_3_code = as.character(Alpha_3_code),
    region_raw = as.character(.data[[region_source_col]]),
    region_group = case_when(
      Alpha_3_code == "CHN" ~ "China",
      Alpha_3_code == "USA" ~ "United States",
      region_raw %in% europe_subregions ~ "Europe",
      TRUE ~ "Other regions"
    ),
    region_group = factor(region_group, levels = region_order)
  )

regional_sample_summary <- data_base %>%
  group_by(region_group) %>%
  summarise(
    N_obs = n(),
    N_units = n_distinct(GEM_unit_phase_ID),
    N_events = sum(retire == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Region = region_group)

cat("\nGeographic-group sample sizes:\n")
print(regional_sample_summary)

# ============================================================
# 2. Model settings
# ============================================================

pre_periods <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19")
target_period <- "20_24"

measure_specs <- list(
  "All data centers" = list(
    prefix = "ai_proximity_25km",
    slope_prefix = "all"
  ),
  "Larger data centers" = list(
    prefix = "ai_larger_25km",
    slope_prefix = "large"
  )
)

region_code_map <- c(
  "Other regions" = "other",
  "China" = "china",
  "United States" = "usa",
  "Europe" = "europe"
)

control_vars <- c(
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct"
)

# ============================================================
# 3. Estimate one model
# ============================================================

run_one_measure <- function(measure_name, measure_spec) {

  prefix <- measure_spec$prefix
  pre_vars <- paste0(prefix, "_", pre_periods)
  target_var <- paste0(prefix, "_", target_period)

  missing_vars <- setdiff(
    c(pre_vars, target_var, control_vars),
    names(data_base)
  )

  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing variables: ",
      paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  data_model <- data_base
  slope_vars <- character()
  slope_info <- list()

  for (region_name in names(region_code_map)) {
    region_code <- region_code_map[[region_name]]

    slope_var <- paste0(
      "dce_",
      measure_spec$slope_prefix,
      "_25km_",
      region_code
    )

    data_model[[slope_var]] <- ifelse(
      data_model$region_group == region_name,
      data_model[[target_var]],
      0
    )

    slope_vars <- c(slope_vars, slope_var)

    slope_info[[length(slope_info) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Region = region_name,
      Slope_variable = slope_var
    )
  }

  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(c(pre_vars, slope_vars, control_vars), collapse = " + "),
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )

  cat("\nRunning:", measure_name, "\n")

  cox_model <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = data_model,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )

  beta_hat <- coef(cox_model)
  variance_matrix <- vcov(cox_model)
  slope_info <- bind_rows(slope_info)

  results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(slope_info)), function(i) {
    region_name <- slope_info$Region[i]
    var_name <- slope_info$Slope_variable[i]

    if (!var_name %in% names(beta_hat)) {
      message("Variable not estimated: ", var_name)
      return(NULL)
    }

    beta <- beta_hat[var_name]
    se <- sqrt(variance_matrix[var_name, var_name])
    pval <- 2 * pnorm(abs(beta / se), lower.tail = FALSE)

    data.frame(
      Measure = measure_name,
      Spatial = "25 km",
      Region = region_name,
      Target_variable = target_var,
      Slope_variable = var_name,
      Coefficient = beta,
      SE = se,
      HR = exp(beta),
      CI90_lower = exp(beta - 1.645 * se),
      CI90_upper = exp(beta + 1.645 * se),
      CI95_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
      CI95_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * se),
      P_value = pval,
      Sig = case_when(
        pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
        pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
        pval < 0.10 ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      N_obs = sum(data_model$region_group == region_name),
      N_units = n_distinct(
        data_model$GEM_unit_phase_ID[
          data_model$region_group == region_name
        ]
      ),
      N_events = sum(
        data_model$region_group == region_name &
          data_model$retire == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Nonzero_exposure_n = sum(
        data_model$region_group == region_name &
          data_model[[target_var]] > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Exposed_events = sum(
        data_model$region_group == region_name &
          data_model[[target_var]] > 0 &
          data_model$retire == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Formula = formula_str
    )
  })

  list(
    model = cox_model,
    results = bind_rows(results)
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 4. Run models
# ============================================================

model_outputs <- lapply(
  names(measure_specs),
  function(measure_name) {
    run_one_measure(
      measure_name,
      measure_specs[[measure_name]]
    )
  }
)

names(model_outputs) <- names(measure_specs)

marginal_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(model_outputs, `[[`, "results")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = factor(Region, levels = plot_region_order),
    Measure = factor(
      Measure,
      levels = c(
        "All data centers",
        "Larger data centers"
      )
    ),
    label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Region, Measure)

models_list <- lapply(model_outputs, `[[`, "model")

# ============================================================
# 5. Save results
# ============================================================

saveRDS(
  marginal_results,
  file.path(
    path_temp,
    "sup_fig13_region_marginal_hr.rds"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  models_list,
  file.path(
    path_temp,
    "sup_fig13_region_models.rds"
  )
)

write.csv(
  marginal_results,
  file.path(
    path_tables,
    "sup_fig13_region_marginal_hr.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  regional_sample_summary,
  file.path(
    path_tables,
    "sup_fig13_region_sample_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(
  marginal_results %>%
    select(
      Region, Measure, HR,
      CI90_lower, CI90_upper,
      CI95_lower, CI95_upper,
      P_value, Sig,
      N_obs, N_units, N_events,
      Nonzero_exposure_n, Exposed_events
    )
)

```

```{r sup_fig13_region_plot}
# ============================================================
# Plot: China, United States, Europe and other regions
# 25 km specification, with sample counts
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

marginal_results <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig13_region_marginal_hr.rds"))

plot_region_order <- c("China", "United States", "Europe", "Other regions")

region_short <- c(
  "China" = "CHN",
  "United States" = "USA",
  "Europe" = "Europe",
  "Other regions" = "Other regions"
)

measure_colors <- c(
  "All data centers" = "#FF4500",
  "Larger data centers" = "#9E1C60"
)

measure_offsets <- c(
  "All data centers" = 0.16,
  "Larger data centers" = -0.16
)

sig_symbol <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p < 0.10 ~ "+",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

region_labels_df <- marginal_results %>%
  filter(as.character(Spatial) == "25 km") %>%
  distinct(Region, N_units, N_obs) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = as.character(Region),
    Region_label = sprintf(
      "%s\n(%s units; %s obs.)",
      unname(region_short[Region]),
      format(N_units, big.mark = ","),
      format(N_obs, big.mark = ",")
    )
  )

region_label_map <- setNames(region_labels_df$Region_label, region_labels_df$Region)
region_levels_bottom_to_top <- rev(plot_region_order)

plot_data <- marginal_results %>%
  filter(
    as.character(Spatial) == "25 km",
    is.finite(HR),
    is.finite(CI95_lower),
    is.finite(CI95_upper)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = factor(as.character(Region), levels = region_levels_bottom_to_top),
    Measure = factor(as.character(Measure), levels = c("All data centers", "Larger data centers")),
    Sig_plot = sig_symbol(P_value),
    label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig_plot),
    y_base = as.numeric(Region),
    y_pos = y_base + unname(measure_offsets[as.character(Measure)])
  )

if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) stop("No valid 25 km regional estimates were found.")

x_min_raw <- min(plot_data$CI95_lower, 1, na.rm = TRUE)
x_max_raw <- max(plot_data$CI95_upper, 1, na.rm = TRUE)
x_range <- x_max_raw - x_min_raw
if (!is.finite(x_range) || x_range == 0) x_range <- 0.1

x_limit_min <- max(0.05, x_min_raw - 0.08 * x_range)
x_limit_max <- x_max_raw + 0.25 * x_range

x_breaks <- sort(unique(c(pretty(c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max), n = 5), 1)))
x_breaks <- x_breaks[x_breaks >= x_limit_min & x_breaks <= x_limit_max]

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    HR_plot = pmin(pmax(HR, x_limit_min), x_limit_max),
    CI95_lower_plot = pmax(CI95_lower, x_limit_min),
    CI95_upper_plot = pmin(CI95_upper, x_limit_max),
    label_x = pmin(
      CI95_upper_plot + 0.025 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min),
      x_limit_max - 0.04 * (x_limit_max - x_limit_min)
    )
  )

forest_region_25km <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(color = Measure)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = CI95_lower_plot, xend = CI95_upper_plot, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = HR_plot, y = y_pos),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2,
    stroke = 0.85,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, y = y_pos, label = label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2.5,
    color = "black",
    family = "sans",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = measure_colors, breaks = c("All data centers", "Larger data centers")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(region_levels_bottom_to_top),
    labels = unname(region_label_map[region_levels_bottom_to_top]),
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.45, 0.45))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_limit_min, x_limit_max),
    breaks = x_breaks,
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Region-specific hazard ratio (95% CI)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.2, color = "black", lineheight = 0.88),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 7)),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 30, 8, 8)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(path_figures, "sup_fig13_region_25km.pdf"),
  forest_region_25km,
  width = 5.6,
  height = 3.4,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)

ggsave(

  forest_region_25km,
  width = 5.6,
  height = 3.4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

print(forest_region_25km)
```

```{r sup_fig14_loco_models}
# ============================================================
# Leave-one-country-out robustness: 25 km only
# ============================================================

library(survival)
library(dplyr)

types <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

exposure_specs <- list(
  "All data centers" = paste0("ai_proximity_25km_", types),
  "Larger data centers" = paste0("ai_larger_25km_", types)
)

control_vars <- c(
  "Capacity_MW", "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh", "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output", "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct"
)

top_dc_countries <- c(
  "USA", "CHN", "JPN", "GBR", "DEU",
  "RUS", "FRA", "CAN", "NLD", "AUS"
)

top_coal_countries <- c(
  "CHN", "USA", "IND", "RUS", "POL",
  "DEU", "JPN", "KAZ", "ZAF", "AUS"
)

countries_to_drop <- unique(c(top_dc_countries, top_coal_countries))

country_labels <- c(
  USA = "United States", CHN = "China", JPN = "Japan",
  GBR = "United Kingdom", DEU = "Germany", RUS = "Russia",
  FRA = "France", CAN = "Canada", NLD = "Netherlands",
  AUS = "Australia", IND = "India", POL = "Poland",
  KAZ = "Kazakhstan", ZAF = "South Africa"
)

country_source <- tibble(
  Dropped_country = countries_to_drop,
  Dropped_country_name = unname(country_labels[countries_to_drop]),
  In_top_data_center = countries_to_drop %in% top_dc_countries,
  In_top_coal_sample = countries_to_drop %in% top_coal_countries
) %>%
  mutate(
    Inclusion_source = case_when(
      In_top_data_center & In_top_coal_sample ~ "Both",
      In_top_data_center ~ "Top data-center countries",
      In_top_coal_sample ~ "Top coal-sample countries",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Prepare one common complete-case sample
# ============================================================

required_vars <- c(
  "time0", "time1", "retire", "Alpha_3_code",
  "GEM_unit_phase_ID", control_vars,
  unlist(exposure_specs, use.names = FALSE)
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(data))

if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop("Missing variables: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

data_loco_base <- data %>%
  mutate(Alpha_3_code = as.character(Alpha_3_code)) %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(required_vars), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  select(all_of(required_vars))

cat(
  "Analysis sample:",
  nrow(data_loco_base), "observations;",
  n_distinct(data_loco_base$GEM_unit_phase_ID), "units\n"
)

# ============================================================
# Country sample sizes
# ============================================================

drop_country_summary <- country_source %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Dropped_obs = sum(
      data_loco_base$Alpha_3_code == Dropped_country
    ),
    Dropped_units = n_distinct(
      data_loco_base$GEM_unit_phase_ID[
        data_loco_base$Alpha_3_code == Dropped_country
      ]
    ),
    Dropped_events = sum(
      data_loco_base$Alpha_3_code == Dropped_country &
        data_loco_base$retire == 1
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(
  drop_country_summary,
  file.path(
    path_tables,
    "sup_fig14_loco_dropped_sample_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(drop_country_summary)

# ============================================================
# Fit one Cox model
# ============================================================

run_one_cox_measure <- function(
  data_used,
  measure_name,
  exposure_vars,
  sample_label,
  drop_cty = NA_character_
) {

  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(c(exposure_vars, control_vars), collapse = " + "),
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )

  model <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = data_used,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )

  coef_table <- summary(model)$coefficients
  se_col <- if ("robust se" %in% colnames(coef_table)) {
    "robust se"
  } else {
    "se(coef)"
  }

  result <- lapply(seq_along(types), function(i) {
    var_name <- exposure_vars[i]

    if (!var_name %in% rownames(coef_table)) return(NULL)

    coef_val <- coef_table[var_name, "coef"]
    se <- coef_table[var_name, se_col]
    pval <- coef_table[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]

    data.frame(
      Sample = sample_label,
      Dropped_country = drop_cty,
      Dropped_country_name = ifelse(
        is.na(drop_cty),
        "Full sample",
        unname(country_labels[drop_cty])
      ),
      Specification = "25km",
      Measure = measure_name,
      Type = types[i],
      Variable = var_name,
      Coefficient = coef_val,
      HR = exp(coef_val),
      SE = se,
      CI_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se),
      CI_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se),
      P_value = pval,
      Sig = case_when(
        pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
        pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
        pval < 0.10 ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      N_obs = model$n,
      N_units = n_distinct(data_used$GEM_unit_phase_ID),
      N_events = model$nevent,
      Formula = formula_str
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  rm(model, coef_table)
  invisible(gc())

  result
}

# ============================================================
# Full-sample models
# ============================================================

results_list <- list()

for (measure_name in names(exposure_specs)) {
  results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- run_one_cox_measure(
    data_used = data_loco_base,
    measure_name = measure_name,
    exposure_vars = exposure_specs[[measure_name]],
    sample_label = "Full sample"
  )

  cat("Finished full sample:", measure_name, "\n")
}

# ============================================================
# Leave-one-country-out models
# ============================================================

for (drop_cty in countries_to_drop) {

  data_sub <- data_loco_base[
    data_loco_base$Alpha_3_code != drop_cty,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  cat(
    "\nDropping", drop_cty,
    paste0("(", country_labels[[drop_cty]], ")"),
    "-", nrow(data_sub), "observations\n"
  )

  for (measure_name in names(exposure_specs)) {
    result <- tryCatch(
      run_one_cox_measure(
        data_used = data_sub,
        measure_name = measure_name,
        exposure_vars = exposure_specs[[measure_name]],
        sample_label = paste0("Drop ", drop_cty),
        drop_cty = drop_cty
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message(
          "Model failed: ", drop_cty, " | ",
          measure_name, " | ", e$message
        )
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(result)) {
      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- result
    }
  }

  rm(data_sub, result)
  invisible(gc())
}

# ============================================================
# Combine and save
# ============================================================

results_loco_25km <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  left_join(
    country_source,
    by = c("Dropped_country", "Dropped_country_name")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Specification = factor(Specification, levels = "25km"),
    Dropped_country = factor(
      Dropped_country,
      levels = countries_to_drop
    ),
    Measure = factor(
      Measure,
      levels = c("All data centers", "Larger data centers")
    ),
    Type = factor(Type, levels = types)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Dropped_country, Measure, Type)

saveRDS(
  results_loco_25km,
  file.path(
    path_temp,
    "sup_fig14_loco_results.rds"
  )
)

results_csv <- results_loco_25km %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(Specification, Dropped_country, Measure, Type),
      as.character
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Formula)

write.csv(
  results_csv,
  file.path(
    path_tables,
    "sup_fig14_loco_results.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  results_csv,
  file.path(
    path_tables,
    "sup_fig14_loco_source.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(
  results_loco_25km %>%
    filter(Type == "20_24") %>%
    select(
      Sample, Dropped_country, Measure,
      HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig,
      N_obs, N_units, N_events
    )
)
```        

```{r sup_fig06_survivor2020_models}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

# =========================
# 1. Restrict sample to units surviving to 2020
#    Keep all observations for these units
# =========================

units_surviving_to_2020 <- data %>%
  group_by(GEM_unit_phase_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    retired_before_2020 = any(retire == 1 & year < 2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    observed_in_or_after_2020 = any(year >= 2020, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!retired_before_2020 & observed_in_or_after_2020) %>%
  pull(GEM_unit_phase_ID)

data_survivor2020 <- data %>%
  filter(GEM_unit_phase_ID %in% units_surviving_to_2020) %>%
  arrange(GEM_unit_phase_ID, year, time0, time1)

cat("Restricted sample summary (units surviving to 2020):\n")
cat(sprintf("Rows kept: %d\n", nrow(data_survivor2020)))
cat(sprintf("Units kept: %d\n", n_distinct(data_survivor2020$GEM_unit_phase_ID)))
cat(sprintf("Events kept: %d\n\n", sum(data_survivor2020$retire, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Optional diagnostic check
check_entry <- data_survivor2020 %>%
  group_by(GEM_unit_phase_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    ever_retired = any(retire == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(head(check_entry, 10))

# =========================
# 2. Define treatment variables
# =========================

distances <- c("25km")
types <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

results_list <- list()
cox_models_list <- list()

# =========================
# 3. Cox models on restricted sample
# =========================

for (dist in distances) {
  
  proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", dist, "_", types)
  proximity_formula <- paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + ")
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    proximity_formula,
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year",
    " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
    " + td_loss_pct_output",
    " + demand_yoy_pct",
    " + renew_gen_share_pct",
    " + strata(Country_Area)"
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    
    cox_model <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str),
      data = data_survivor2020,
      cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
    )
    
    coef_summary <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients
    has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
    
    n_obs <- cox_model$n
    n_events <- cox_model$nevent
    
    for (var_name in proximity_vars) {
      
      type <- sub(paste0("^ai_proximity_", dist, "_"), "", var_name)
      
      if (!(var_name %in% rownames(coef_summary))) next
      
      if (has_robust) {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[var_name, "robust se"]
        pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      } else {
        coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
        se <- coef_summary[var_name, "se(coef)"]
        pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      }
      
      hr <- exp(coef_val)
      ci_lower <- exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se)
      ci_upper <- exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se)
      
      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        Distance = dist,
        Type = type,
        Variable = var_name,
        Coefficient = coef_val,
        HR = hr,
        SE = se,
        CI_lower = ci_lower,
        CI_upper = ci_upper,
        P_value = pval,
        Sig = case_when(
          pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
          pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
          pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        N_obs = n_obs,
        N_events = n_events
      )
    }
    
    cox_models_list[[paste0(dist, "_all_types_survivor2020")]] <- cox_model
    cat(sprintf("✓ Fitted survivor-to-2020 model: %s\n", dist))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("✗ Error for %s: %s\n", dist, e$message))
  })
}

# =========================
# 4. Output results
# =========================

if (length(results_list) == 0) {
  stop("No models successfully fitted.")
}

results_df_survivor2020 <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(Distance_num = as.numeric(gsub("km", "", Distance))) %>%
  arrange(Distance_num)

saveRDS(results_df_survivor2020, file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig06_survivor2020_results.rds"))
write.csv(results_df_survivor2020, file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig06_survivor2020_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nAnalysis completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Total models fitted: %d\n", length(cox_models_list)))
cat(sprintf("Total coefficients: %d\n", nrow(results_df_survivor2020)))
cat(sprintf("Significant results (p < 0.05): %d\n\n",
            sum(results_df_survivor2020$P_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))

print(
  results_df_survivor2020 %>%
    select(Distance, Type, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig, N_obs, N_events)
)
```

```{r sup_fig06_survivor2020_plot}
# ============================================================
# 3. Prepare plotting data

plot_data <- results_df_survivor2020 %>%
  filter(Distance == "25km") %>%

    Type_clean = recode(
```

```{r fig_4a_b_hetero_calculate_section}

library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Configuration
FOCAL_DISTANCE <- "25km"
FOCAL_TYPE <- "20_24"
FOCAL_VAR <- paste0("ai_proximity_", FOCAL_DISTANCE, "_", FOCAL_TYPE)

# Step 1: Prepare Data with Standardized Variables
prepare_interaction_data <- function(data) {
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh = as.numeric(as.vector(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh)),
      co2_intensity = as.numeric(as.vector(co2_intensity))
    )
  
  stats <- data %>%
    summarise(
      AI_mean = mean(.data[[FOCAL_VAR]], na.rm = TRUE),
      AI_sd = sd(.data[[FOCAL_VAR]], na.rm = TRUE),
      HR_mean = mean(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh, na.rm = TRUE),
      HR_sd = sd(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh, na.rm = TRUE),
      CO2_mean = mean(co2_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      CO2_sd = sd(co2_intensity, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  assign("heterogeneity_stats", stats, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  focal_var_std <- paste0(FOCAL_VAR, "_std")
  
  data_prepared <- data %>%
    mutate(
      !!focal_var_std := (.data[[FOCAL_VAR]] - stats$AI_mean) / stats$AI_sd,
      Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std = (Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh - stats$HR_mean) / stats$HR_sd,
      co2_intensity_std = (co2_intensity - stats$CO2_mean) / stats$CO2_sd,
      AI_x_Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std = .data[[focal_var_std]] * Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std,
      AI_x_co2_intensity_std = .data[[focal_var_std]] * co2_intensity_std
    )
  
  return(data_prepared)
}

# Step 2: Define Interaction Models
run_interaction_model <- function(data, interaction_var, interaction_name) {
  
  interaction_term <- paste0("AI_x_", interaction_var)
  focal_var_std <- paste0(FOCAL_VAR, "_std")
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[interaction_var]]) & is.finite(.data[[interaction_var]]))
  
  cat(sprintf("Sample: N=%d observations\n", nrow(df)))
  
  other_proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", FOCAL_DISTANCE, "_", 
                                 c("before06", "06_15", "16_19"))
  
  main_effects <- c(
    other_proximity_vars,
    focal_var_std,
    interaction_var,
    "Capacity_MW",
    "Start_year",
    "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    "rGDP_pc",
    "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
    "td_loss_pct_output",
    "demand_yoy_pct",
    "renew_gen_share_pct"
  )
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(main_effects, collapse = " + "),
    " + ", interaction_term,
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  cat("\nModel Formula:\n")
  cat(formula_str, "\n\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    
    cox_model <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str),
      data = df,
      cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
    )
    
    coef_summary <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients
    
    main_row <- which(rownames(coef_summary) == focal_var_std)
    int_row <- which(rownames(coef_summary) == interaction_term)
    mod_row <- which(rownames(coef_summary) == interaction_var)
    
    se_col <- ifelse("robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary), "robust se", "se(coef)")
    
    main_coef <- coef_summary[main_row, "coef"]
    main_se <- coef_summary[main_row, se_col]
    main_pval <- coef_summary[main_row, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    int_coef <- coef_summary[int_row, "coef"]
    int_se <- coef_summary[int_row, se_col]
    int_pval <- coef_summary[int_row, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    mod_coef <- if(length(mod_row) > 0) coef_summary[mod_row, "coef"] else NA
    mod_se <- if(length(mod_row) > 0) coef_summary[mod_row, se_col] else NA
    mod_pval <- if(length(mod_row) > 0) coef_summary[mod_row, "Pr(>|z|)"] else NA
    
    get_sig <- function(p) {
      case_when(
        p < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p < 0.01 ~ "**",
        p < 0.05 ~ "*",
        p < 0.1 ~ "+",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    }
    
    main_sig <- get_sig(main_pval)
    int_sig <- get_sig(int_pval)
    
    me_at_mean <- main_coef
    me_at_plus1sd <- main_coef + int_coef
    me_at_minus1sd <- main_coef - int_coef
    
    cat("\n----------------------------------------\n")
    cat("Results:\n")
    cat("----------------------------------------\n")
    cat(sprintf("Main Effect (AI, standardized):     β=%.4f (SE=%.4f), HR=%.3f, p=%.4f %s\n",
                main_coef, main_se, exp(main_coef), main_pval, main_sig))
    cat(sprintf("Moderator Effect (%s, std):         β=%.4f (SE=%.4f), HR=%.3f, p=%.4f\n",
                interaction_name, mod_coef, mod_se, exp(mod_coef), mod_pval))
    cat(sprintf("Interaction (AI × %s):              β=%.4f (SE=%.4f), p=%.4f %s\n",
                interaction_name, int_coef, int_se, int_pval, int_sig))
    cat("\nMarginal Effects of AI (per 1 SD increase):\n")
    cat(sprintf("  When Moderator at Mean (Z=0):      β=%.4f, HR=%.3f\n", 
                me_at_mean, exp(me_at_mean)))
    cat(sprintf("  When Moderator at Mean+1SD (Z=+1): β=%.4f, HR=%.3f\n", 
                me_at_plus1sd, exp(me_at_plus1sd)))
    cat(sprintf("  When Moderator at Mean-1SD (Z=-1): β=%.4f, HR=%.3f\n", 
                me_at_minus1sd, exp(me_at_minus1sd)))
    cat("----------------------------------------\n")
    
    n_obs <- cox_model$n
    n_retirements <- cox_model$nevent
    model_rows <- as.numeric(names(cox_model$residuals))
    df_actual <- df[model_rows, ]
    n_units <- n_distinct(df_actual$GEM_unit_phase_ID)
    n_countries <- n_distinct(df_actual$Alpha_3_code)
    
    return(data.frame(
      Moderator = interaction_name,
      N_Observations = n_obs,
      N_units = n_units,
      N_Countries = n_countries,
      N_Retirements = n_retirements,
      Main_Coef = main_coef,
      Main_SE = main_se,
      Main_HR = exp(main_coef),
      Main_P = main_pval,
      Main_Sig = main_sig,
      Moderator_Coef = mod_coef,
      Moderator_SE = mod_se,
      Moderator_HR = exp(mod_coef),
      Moderator_P = mod_pval,
      Interaction_Coef = int_coef,
      Interaction_SE = int_se,
      Interaction_P = int_pval,
      Interaction_Sig = int_sig,
      ME_at_Mean = me_at_mean,
      ME_at_Mean_HR = exp(me_at_mean),
      ME_at_Plus1SD = me_at_plus1sd,
      ME_at_Plus1SD_HR = exp(me_at_plus1sd),
      ME_at_Minus1SD = me_at_minus1sd,
      ME_at_Minus1SD_HR = exp(me_at_minus1sd),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("✗ Error: %s\n", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Step 3: Run
data_prepared <- prepare_interaction_data(data)

moderators <- list(
  list(var = "co2_intensity_std", name = "CO2 Intensity"),
  list(var = "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std", name = "Heat Rate")
)

all_results <- lapply(moderators, function(mod) {
  run_interaction_model(data_prepared, mod$var, mod$name)
})

results_interaction <- bind_rows(all_results[!sapply(all_results, is.null)])

# Step 4: Format and Save Results
results_formatted <- results_interaction %>%
  mutate(
    Moderator = factor(Moderator, levels = c("CO2 Intensity", "Heat Rate"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Moderator) %>%
  mutate(
    `DCE2020-2024 Coef. [95% CI]` = sprintf(
      "%.4f%s [%.4f, %.4f]",
      Main_Coef, Main_Sig,
      Main_Coef - 1.96 * Main_SE,
      Main_Coef + 1.96 * Main_SE
    ),
    `HR [95% CI]` = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      Main_HR,
      exp(Main_Coef - 1.96 * Main_SE),
      exp(Main_Coef + 1.96 * Main_SE)
    ),
    `Interact term [95% CI]` = sprintf(
      "%.4f%s [%.4f, %.4f]",
      Interaction_Coef, Interaction_Sig,
      Interaction_Coef - 1.96 * Interaction_SE,
      Interaction_Coef + 1.96 * Interaction_SE
    ),
    `Interact p-value` = sprintf("%.4f", Interaction_P)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Moderator,
    `DCE2020-2024 Coef. [95% CI]`,
    `HR [95% CI]`,
    `Interact term [95% CI]`,
    `Interact p-value`,
    N_Observations,
    N_units,
    N_Retirements
  ) %>%
  rename(
    `Moderating Variable` = Moderator,
    `N (Obs.)` = N_Observations,
    `N (Units)` = N_units,
    `N (Retired)` = N_Retirements
  )

print(results_formatted, row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(results_interaction, file.path(path_temp, "sup_table08_co2_heat_interactions.rds"))
write.csv(
  results_formatted,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_table08_co2_heat_interactions_source.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r fig_4a_b_plot_section}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

COLOR_HIGH <- "#B8001F"    # Mean+1SD
COLOR_MEAN <- "#FF4500"    # Mean
COLOR_LOW <- "#48CFCB"     # Mean-1SD

theme_nature <- theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(

    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 4)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 4)),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30", hjust = 0),
    
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )


create_moderation_plot <- function(moderator_name, 
                                  main_coef, 
                                  interaction_coef,
                                  main_se,
                                  interaction_se,
                                  moderator_label = NULL,
                                  use_expression = FALSE, 
                                  show_legend = TRUE) {
  
  if (is.null(moderator_label)) moderator_label <- moderator_name
  
  # Calculate marginal effects
  z_values <- seq(-2, 2, by = 0.1)
  
  marginal_effects <- data.frame(
    z = z_values,
    beta = main_coef + interaction_coef * z_values
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      se = sqrt(main_se^2 + (z * interaction_se)^2),
      hr = exp(beta),
      hr_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
      hr_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * se)
    )
  
  key_points <- data.frame(
    z = c(-1, 0, 1),
    label = factor(c("Mean-1SD (Low)", "Mean", "Mean+1SD (High)"),
                  levels = c("Mean-1SD (Low)", "Mean", "Mean+1SD (High)"))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      beta = main_coef + interaction_coef * z,
      se = sqrt(main_se^2 + (z * interaction_se)^2),
      hr = exp(beta),
      hr_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
      hr_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * se)
    )
  
  # Significance markers
  interaction_p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(interaction_coef / interaction_se)))
  
  subtitle_text <- sprintf(
    "Interaction: Coef = %.3f, SE = %.3f, p %s",
    interaction_coef,
    interaction_se,
    ifelse(interaction_p < 0.001, "< 0.001",
           ifelse(interaction_p < 0.01, "< 0.01",
                  ifelse(interaction_p < 0.05, "< 0.05",
                         sprintf("= %.3f", interaction_p))))
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(marginal_effects, aes(x = z, y = hr)) +
    
    # reference line (HR = 1)
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
    
    # Confidence intervals
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = hr_lower, ymax = hr_upper), 
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey50") +
    
    # line
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    
    # points
    geom_point(data = key_points, 
               aes(x = z, y = hr, color = label),
               size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.2) +
    
    # error bar
    geom_errorbar(data = key_points,
                  aes(x = z, ymin = hr_lower, ymax = hr_upper, color = label),
                  width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.6) +
    
    # color
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Mean-1SD (Low)" = COLOR_LOW,
      "Mean" = COLOR_MEAN,
      "Mean+1SD (High)" = COLOR_HIGH
    )) +
    
    # X-axis
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
      labels = c("-2SD", "-1SD", "Mean", "+1SD", "+2SD")
    ) +
    
    # Y-axis
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0.2, 1.6, by = 0.2),
      labels = sprintf("%.1f", seq(0.2, 1.6, by = 0.2)),
      limits = c(0.2, 1.6)
    ) +
    
    theme_nature +
    theme(
      legend.position = c(0.05, 0.05),
      legend.justification = c(0, 0),
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
  
  if (use_expression) {
    p <- p + labs(
      title = moderator_name,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = moderator_label,  
      y = "Hazard Ratio"
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + labs(
      title = moderator_name,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = paste0(moderator_label, " (Standardized)"),
      y = "Hazard Ratio"
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r interaction cluster sensitivity}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

# ============================================================
# Spatial-clustering sensitivity for Fig. 4 heterogeneity models
#
# Requires:
#   data, path_temp, path_tables and path_figures
#
# The same complete-case sample is used across all clustering
# definitions within each moderator.
# ============================================================

FOCAL_DISTANCE <- "25km"
FOCAL_TYPE <- "20_24"
FOCAL_VAR <- paste0(
  "ai_proximity_",
  FOCAL_DISTANCE,
  "_",
  FOCAL_TYPE
)

OTHER_DCE_VARS <- paste0(
  "ai_proximity_",
  FOCAL_DISTANCE,
  "_",
  c("before06", "06_15", "16_19")
)

CONTROL_VARS <- c(
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct"
)

SURVIVAL_VARS <- c(
  "time0",
  "time1",
  "retire",
  "Alpha_3_code"
)

CLUSTER_SPECS <- c(
  "Generation unit" = "GEM_unit_phase_ID",
  "Plant" = "Plant_name",
  "GID 2" = "GID_2",
  "GID 1" = "GID_1",
  "GID 0" = "GID_0"
)

CLUSTER_ORDER <- names(CLUSTER_SPECS)

MODERATORS <- list(
  list(
    source_var = "co2_intensity",
    std_var = "co2_intensity_std",
    interaction_var = "DCE_x_co2_intensity_std",
    label = expression(CO[2] * " intensity")
  ),
  list(
    source_var = "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    std_var = "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std",
    interaction_var = "DCE_x_Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh_std",
    label = "Heat rate"
  )
)

sig_symbol <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p < 0.10 ~ "+",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

check_variables <- function(df, vars) {
  missing_vars <- setdiff(vars, names(df))

  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing variables:\n",
      paste(missing_vars, collapse = "\n")
    )
  }
}

standardize_variable <- function(x, variable_name) {
  x_mean <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_sd <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.finite(x_sd) || x_sd <= 0) {
    stop(variable_name, " has zero or invalid standard deviation.")
  }

  list(
    value = (x - x_mean) / x_sd,
    mean = x_mean,
    sd = x_sd
  )
}

prepare_common_sample <- function(df, moderator) {
  required_vars <- unique(c(
    FOCAL_VAR,
    OTHER_DCE_VARS,
    CONTROL_VARS,
    SURVIVAL_VARS,
    unname(CLUSTER_SPECS),
    moderator$source_var
  ))

  check_variables(df, required_vars)

  prepared <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh =
        as.numeric(as.vector(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh)),
      co2_intensity =
        as.numeric(as.vector(co2_intensity))
    ) %>%
    filter(if_all(
      all_of(required_vars),
      ~ !is.na(.x)
    ))

  dce_scaled <- standardize_variable(
    prepared[[FOCAL_VAR]],
    FOCAL_VAR
  )

  moderator_scaled <- standardize_variable(
    prepared[[moderator$source_var]],
    moderator$source_var
  )

  prepared$DCE_20_24_std <- dce_scaled$value
  prepared[[moderator$std_var]] <- moderator_scaled$value
  prepared[[moderator$interaction_var]] <-
    prepared$DCE_20_24_std *
    prepared[[moderator$std_var]]

  attr(prepared, "DCE_mean") <- dce_scaled$mean
  attr(prepared, "DCE_sd") <- dce_scaled$sd
  attr(prepared, "Moderator_mean") <- moderator_scaled$mean
  attr(prepared, "Moderator_sd") <- moderator_scaled$sd

  prepared
}

make_formula <- function(moderator) {
  # Heat rate is represented by its standardized main effect in
  # the heat-rate model, so the raw heat-rate control is removed
  # to avoid including two exact linear transformations.
  controls_this_model <- CONTROL_VARS

  if (moderator$source_var == "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh") {
    controls_this_model <- setdiff(
      controls_this_model,
      "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh"
    )
  }

  rhs_vars <- c(
    OTHER_DCE_VARS,
    "DCE_20_24_std",
    moderator$std_var,
    moderator$interaction_var,
    controls_this_model,
    "strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )

  as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(rhs_vars, collapse = " + ")
  ))
}

extract_term <- function(fit, term) {
  coef_table <- summary(fit)$coefficients

  if (!(term %in% rownames(coef_table))) {
    stop("Term was not estimated: ", term)
  }

  se_column <- if (
    "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_table)
  ) {
    "robust se"
  } else {
    "se(coef)"
  }

  beta <- coef_table[term, "coef"]
  se <- coef_table[term, se_column]
  p_value <- coef_table[term, "Pr(>|z|)"]

  data.frame(
    Coefficient = beta,
    SE = se,
    CI_lower = beta - 1.96 * se,
    CI_upper = beta + 1.96 * se,
    P_value = p_value,
    Sig = sig_symbol(p_value),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extract_marginal_effects <- function(
    fit,
    main_term,
    interaction_term
) {
  beta <- coef(fit)
  variance <- vcov(fit)

  b_main <- unname(beta[main_term])
  b_interaction <- unname(beta[interaction_term])

  bind_rows(lapply(
    c(-1, 0, 1),
    function(z) {
      marginal_beta <- b_main + z * b_interaction

      marginal_variance <-
        variance[main_term, main_term] +
        z^2 * variance[interaction_term, interaction_term] +
        2 * z * variance[main_term, interaction_term]

      marginal_se <- sqrt(max(marginal_variance, 0))

      data.frame(
        Moderator_Z = z,
        Marginal_Coefficient = marginal_beta,
        Marginal_SE = marginal_se,
        Marginal_HR = exp(marginal_beta),
        Marginal_HR_lower =
          exp(marginal_beta - 1.96 * marginal_se),
        Marginal_HR_upper =
          exp(marginal_beta + 1.96 * marginal_se),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  ))
}

run_cluster_sensitivity <- function(df, moderator) {
  model_data <- prepare_common_sample(df, moderator)
  model_formula <- make_formula(moderator)

  cat(
    "\nModerator:", moderator$source_var,
    "\nCommon sample:", nrow(model_data), "observations",
    "\nFormula:", deparse(model_formula),
    "\n"
  )

  model_results <- list()
  marginal_results <- list()
  model_objects <- list()

  for (cluster_label in CLUSTER_ORDER) {
    cluster_var <- unname(CLUSTER_SPECS[cluster_label])
    model_data_this_cluster <- model_data %>%
      mutate(
        .cluster_id = .data[[cluster_var]]
      )

    cat(
      "Running", moderator$source_var,
      "- cluster by", cluster_label, "\n"
    )

    fit <- coxph(
      formula = model_formula,
      data = model_data_this_cluster,
      cluster = .cluster_id,
      ties = "efron",
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200),
      x = FALSE,
      y = FALSE,
      model = FALSE
    )

    interaction_result <- extract_term(
      fit,
      moderator$interaction_var
    )

    model_results[[cluster_label]] <- bind_cols(
      data.frame(
        Moderator = moderator$source_var,
        Cluster_definition = cluster_label,
        Cluster_variable = cluster_var,
        N_clusters =
          n_distinct(model_data_this_cluster$.cluster_id),
        N_obs = fit$n,
        N_units =
          n_distinct(
            model_data_this_cluster$GEM_unit_phase_ID
          ),
        N_events = fit$nevent,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ),
      interaction_result
    )

    marginal_results[[cluster_label]] <-
      extract_marginal_effects(
        fit,
        main_term = "DCE_20_24_std",
        interaction_term = moderator$interaction_var
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Moderator = moderator$source_var,
        Cluster_definition = cluster_label,
        Cluster_variable = cluster_var,
        N_clusters =
          n_distinct(
            model_data_this_cluster$.cluster_id
          )
      )

    model_objects[[cluster_label]] <- fit
  }

  list(
    interactions = bind_rows(model_results),
    marginal_effects = bind_rows(marginal_results),
    models = model_objects,
    scaling = data.frame(
      Moderator = moderator$source_var,
      DCE_mean = attr(model_data, "DCE_mean"),
      DCE_SD = attr(model_data, "DCE_sd"),
      Moderator_mean = attr(model_data, "Moderator_mean"),
      Moderator_SD = attr(model_data, "Moderator_sd"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Run models
# ============================================================

# Remove large model objects left by an earlier run of this section.
objects_to_clear <- intersect(
  c(
    "all_outputs",
    "interaction_results",
    "marginal_results",
    "scaling_results",
    "model_objects"
  ),
  ls(envir = .GlobalEnv)
)

if (length(objects_to_clear) > 0) {
  rm(list = objects_to_clear, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

gc()

all_outputs <- lapply(
  MODERATORS,
  function(moderator) {
    run_cluster_sensitivity(data, moderator)
  }
)

interaction_results <- bind_rows(lapply(
  all_outputs,
  `[[`,
  "interactions"
))

marginal_results <- bind_rows(lapply(
  all_outputs,
  `[[`,
  "marginal_effects"
))

scaling_results <- bind_rows(lapply(
  all_outputs,
  `[[`,
  "scaling"
))

model_objects <- setNames(
  lapply(all_outputs, `[[`, "models"),
  vapply(
    MODERATORS,
    function(x) x$source_var,
    character(1)
  )
)

moderator_labels <- c(
  "co2_intensity" = "CO2 intensity",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh" = "Heat rate"
)

interaction_results <- interaction_results %>%
  mutate(
    Moderator_label =
      unname(moderator_labels[Moderator]),
    Cluster_definition = factor(
      Cluster_definition,
      levels = rev(CLUSTER_ORDER)
    ),
    Result_label = sprintf(
      "%.3f%s",
      Coefficient,
      Sig
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Save model outputs
# ============================================================

saveRDS(
  model_objects,
  file.path(
    path_temp,
    "sup_table10_hete_cluster_source.rds"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  interaction_results,
  file.path(
    path_temp,
    "sup_table10_hete_cluster.rds"
  )
)

write.csv(
  interaction_results,
  file.path(
    path_tables,
    "sup_table10_hete_cluster.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r fig_4c_hetero_calculation_section}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Configuration
FOCAL_DISTANCE <- "25km"
FOCAL_TYPE <- "20_24"
FOCAL_VAR <- paste0("ai_proximity_", FOCAL_DISTANCE, "_", FOCAL_TYPE)

prepare_emission_group_data <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ = as.numeric(as.vector(Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ)),
      EF_Group = case_when(
        Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ == 94600 ~ "Bituminous",
        Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ == 96100 ~ "Sub-bituminous",
        Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ == 98300 ~ "Anthracite",
        Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ == 101000 ~ "Lignite",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      EF_Group = factor(
        EF_Group,
        levels = c("Bituminous", "Sub-bituminous", "Anthracite", "Lignite")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(EF_Group)) %>%
    mutate(EF_Group = relevel(EF_Group, ref = "Lignite"))
}

run_emission_group_interaction_model <- function(data) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(EF_Group))
  
  other_proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", FOCAL_DISTANCE, "_",
                                 c("before06", "06_15", "16_19"))
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(other_proximity_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " + ", FOCAL_VAR,
    " * EF_Group",
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
    " + td_loss_pct_output",
    " + demand_yoy_pct",
    " + renew_gen_share_pct",    
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  cat("\nModel Formula:\n")
  cat(formula_str, "\n\n")
  
  cox_model <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = df,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )
  
  used_rows <- as.numeric(rownames(model.frame(cox_model)))
  df_actual <- df[used_rows, , drop = FALSE]
  
  n_obs <- nrow(df_actual)
  n_retirements <- sum(df_actual$retire, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_units <- n_distinct(df_actual$GEM_unit_phase_ID)
  
  b <- coef(cox_model)
  V <- vcov(cox_model)
  coef_names <- names(b)
  
  base_name <- FOCAL_VAR
  if (!(base_name %in% coef_names)) {
    stop(sprintf("Base coefficient %s not found.", base_name))
  }
  
  ref_group <- "Lignite"
  groups <- levels(df$EF_Group)
  results_list <- list()
  
  for (g in groups) {
    
    if (g == ref_group) {
      diff_coef <- 0
      diff_se <- NA
      diff_p <- NA
      ci_lower <- NA
      ci_upper <- NA
    } else {
      int_name1 <- paste0(FOCAL_VAR, ":EF_Group", g)
      int_name2 <- paste0("EF_Group", g, ":", FOCAL_VAR)
      int_name <- if (int_name1 %in% coef_names) int_name1 else int_name2
      
      if (!(int_name %in% coef_names)) {
        stop(sprintf("Interaction term for group %s not found.", g))
      }
      
      L_diff <- rep(0, length(b))
      names(L_diff) <- coef_names
      L_diff[int_name] <- 1
      
      diff_coef <- sum(L_diff * b)
      diff_se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(L_diff) %*% V %*% L_diff))
      diff_z <- diff_coef / diff_se
      diff_p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(diff_z)))
      ci_lower <- diff_coef - 1.96 * diff_se
      ci_upper <- diff_coef + 1.96 * diff_se
    }
    
    results_list[[g]] <- data.frame(
      EF_Group = g,
      N_Observations = n_obs,
      N_Units = n_units,
      N_Retirements = n_retirements,
      Interaction_Coef = diff_coef,
      Interaction_SE = diff_se,
      Interaction_CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      Interaction_CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      Interaction_P = diff_p,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
  
  return(list(
    model = cox_model,
    vcov = V,
    results = results_df
  ))
}

# Run
data_emission_group <- prepare_emission_group_data(data)
emission_group_output <- run_emission_group_interaction_model(data_emission_group)

results_emission_group <- emission_group_output$results

results_emission_group_table <- results_emission_group %>%
  mutate(
    `Interaction coef. [95% CI]` = case_when(
      EF_Group == "Lignite" ~ "Reference",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.4f [%.4f, %.4f]",
                     Interaction_Coef,
                     Interaction_CI_Lower,
                     Interaction_CI_Upper)
    ),
    `p-value` = case_when(
      EF_Group == "Lignite" ~ "",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.4f", Interaction_P)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Emission Factor Group` = EF_Group,
    `Interaction coef. [95% CI]`,
    `p-value`,
    `N (Observations)` = N_Observations,
    `N (Units)` = N_Units,
    `N (Retirements)` = N_Retirements
  )

write.csv(
  results_emission_group_table,
  file = file.path(path_tables, "sup_table09_coal_type_interactions_source.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

print(results_emission_group_table, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r sup_fig07_placebo_models}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(parallel)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

dist <- "25km"
proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", dist, "_", c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24"))

formula_str <- paste0(
  "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
  paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + "),
  " + Capacity_MW + Start_year + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh + rGDP_pc + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw + td_loss_pct_output + demand_yoy_pct + renew_gen_share_pct + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
)

target_var   <- "ai_proximity_25km_20_24"
id_var       <- "GEM_unit_phase_ID"

# Estimate the observed post-2020 DCE coefficient

cox_true <- coxph(
  as.formula(formula_str),
  data = data,
  cluster = data[[id_var]],
  ties = "efron"
)

true_coef <- unname(coef(cox_true)[target_var])
true_se <- summary(cox_true)$coefficients[target_var, "se(coef)"]
true_pval <- summary(cox_true)$coefficients[target_var, "Pr(>|z|)"]
true_hr <- exp(true_coef)


# Randomly permute post-2020 DCE for placebo simulations

placebo_iteration_full_sample <- function(i, data, target_var, 
                                          id_var, formula_str) {
  set.seed(100000 + i)
  
  df <- data
  
  idx_non_na <- !is.na(df[[target_var]])
  
  if (sum(idx_non_na) > 0) {
    values_to_shuffle <- df[[target_var]][idx_non_na]
    shuffled_values <- sample(values_to_shuffle, length(values_to_shuffle), replace = FALSE)
    df[[target_var]][idx_non_na] <- shuffled_values
  }
  
  # run cox
  tryCatch({
    cox_placebo <- coxph(
      as.formula(formula_str),
      data = df,
      cluster = df[[id_var]],
      ties = "efron"
    )
    
    coef_val <- unname(coef(cox_placebo)[target_var])
    se_val <- summary(cox_placebo)$coefficients[target_var, "se(coef)"]
    pval_val <- summary(cox_placebo)$coefficients[target_var, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    return(c(iter = i, coef = coef_val, se = se_val, pval = pval_val))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(c(iter = i, coef = NA, se = NA, pval = NA))
  })
}

# Run 500 placebo permutations

n_iter <- 500
n_cores <- min(detectCores() - 1, 8)

cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)

clusterExport(cl, c("data", "target_var", "id_var", "formula_str",
                    "placebo_iteration_full_sample"),
              envir = environment())

invisible(clusterEvalQ(cl, {
  library(survival)
  library(dplyr)
}))

start_time <- Sys.time()
placebo_list <- parLapply(
  cl, 1:n_iter,
  function(i) placebo_iteration_full_sample(
    i = i, data = data, target_var = target_var, 
    id_var = id_var, formula_str = formula_str
  )
)
end_time <- Sys.time()

stopCluster(cl)
rm(cl)
gc()

time_elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs"))

# Combine placebo results

placebo_df <- do.call(rbind, placebo_list) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(!is.na(coef))

colnames(placebo_df) <- c("iter", "coef", "se", "pval")

placebo_mean <- mean(placebo_df$coef)
placebo_sd <- sd(placebo_df$coef)

# Summarize the permutation p-value
placebo_p_1sided <- mean(placebo_df$coef <= true_coef)

z_score <- (true_coef - placebo_mean) / placebo_sd
pval_less_005 <- mean(placebo_df$pval < 0.05)

saveRDS(placebo_df, file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig07_random_dce_placebo.rds"))
write.csv(placebo_df, file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig07_random_dce_placebo.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r sup_fig07_placebo_plot}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Calculate key statistics
placebo_mean <- mean(placebo_df$coef)
placebo_sd <- sd(placebo_df$coef)
placebo_p_1sided <- mean(placebo_df$coef <= true_coef)
z_score <- (true_coef - placebo_mean) / placebo_sd

# 1. Calculate kernel density estimation
density_placebo <- density(placebo_df$coef, adjust = 1.1, na.rm = TRUE)
density_df <- data.frame(
  x = density_placebo$x,
  y = density_placebo$y
)

# 2. Trim density curve tails
y_threshold <- max(density_df$y) * 0.01
density_df <- density_df %>%
  filter(y >= y_threshold)

# 3. Color scheme
color_density <- "#111844"
color_null <- "grey35"

# 4. Optimize x-axis range
xlim_range <- range(density_df$x, true_coef, finite = TRUE)
x_padding <- diff(xlim_range) * 0.05
xlim_range <- c(xlim_range[1] - x_padding, xlim_range[2] + x_padding)

# 5. Calculate annotation positions
y_at_true <- approx(density_df$x, density_df$y, xout = true_coef, rule = 2)$y
y_top <- max(density_df$y, na.rm = TRUE)

# True effect label: put on the RIGHT side of dashed line
y_true_label <- max(1.5, y_at_true * 0.15)
x_true_label <- true_coef + 0.002

# Placebo stats text: move MUCH more to the right
x_stats_label <- xlim_range[1] + 0.24 * diff(xlim_range)
y_stats_label <- y_top * 0.95

# 6. Create plot
p <- ggplot() +

  # Density curve
  geom_line(
    data = density_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = color_density,
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +

  # Null reference line
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = color_null,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # True coefficient line (vertical dashed)
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = true_coef,
    color = color_null,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  # Annotate the observed coefficient
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x_true_label,
    y = y_true_label,
    label = "True effect",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0,
    size = 3.4,
    color = color_null
  ) +

  # Annotate placebo summary statistics
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x_stats_label,
    y = y_stats_label,
    label = sprintf(
      "Placebo mean = %.3f\nZ-score = %.2f\np(one-sided) = %.3f\nn = %d",
      placebo_mean, z_score, placebo_p_1sided, nrow(placebo_df)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3.2,
    color = "black",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +

  # Axis settings
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = xlim_range,
    ylim = c(0, y_top * 1.05),
    expand = FALSE,
    clip = "off"
  ) +

  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Estimator",
    y = "Density",
    title = "Placebo Test: Randomization",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "True: beta = %.4f, HR = %.3f, p = %.4f | Placebo p(one-sided) = %.3f",
      true_coef, true_hr, true_pval, placebo_p_1sided
    )
  ) +

  # Theme settings
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(b = 8)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 18, 6, 6)
  )

# 7. Save figure
dir.create(path_figures, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_figures, "sup_fig07_random_dce_placebo.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 180,
  height = 120,
  units = "mm",
  device = "pdf"
)

print(p)
```

```{r sup_fig08_psm_balance}
sapply(c("MatchIt", "cobalt"), function(pkg) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
})

library(MatchIt)
library(cobalt)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(gtable)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

if (!require(ggtext, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggtext")
library(ggtext)

# ============================================================
# 0. Create treatment indicator if not already available
# ============================================================

if (!("ai_treat_25km_20_24" %in% names(data))) {
  if (!("ai_proximity_25km_20_24" %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Neither ai_treat_25km_20_24 nor ai_proximity_25km_20_24 exists in data.")
  }
  
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      ai_treat_25km_20_24 = ifelse(
        is.na(ai_proximity_25km_20_24),
        NA_integer_,
        as.integer(ai_proximity_25km_20_24 > 0)
      )
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 1. Mark special emission-factor records and replace with NA
# ============================================================

special_ef_values <- c(9460, 9610, 10100)

special_ef_n <- data %>%
  filter(Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ %in% special_ef_values) %>%
  nrow()

cat(sprintf(
  "\nSpecial emission-factor records replaced with NA: %d\n",
  special_ef_n
))

# ============================================================
# 2. Prepare baseline data
# ============================================================

baseline_data <- data %>%
  group_by(GEM_unit_phase_ID) %>%
  arrange(time0) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    treated = as.integer(
      GEM_unit_phase_ID %in%
        (data %>%
           filter(ai_treat_25km_20_24 == 1) %>%
           pull(GEM_unit_phase_ID) %>%
           unique())
    ),
    Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ = ifelse(
      Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ %in% special_ef_values,
      NA,
      Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(treated),
    !is.na(Capacity_MW),
    !is.na(Start_year),
    !is.na(Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh),
    !is.na(Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ),
    !is.na(rGDP_pc),
    !is.na(elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw),
    !is.na(td_loss_pct_output),
    !is.na(demand_yoy_pct),
    !is.na(renew_gen_share_pct)
  )

cat(sprintf("Baseline sample after cleaning: %d units\n", nrow(baseline_data)))
cat(sprintf("Treated units in baseline sample: %d\n", sum(baseline_data$treated == 1)))
cat(sprintf("Control units in baseline sample: %d\n", sum(baseline_data$treated == 0)))

# ============================================================
# 3. Matching
# ============================================================

psm_formula <- treated ~
  Capacity_MW +
  Start_year +
  Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh +
  Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ +
  rGDP_pc +
  elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw +
  td_loss_pct_output +
  demand_yoy_pct +
  renew_gen_share_pct

set.seed(123)
match_out <- matchit(
  psm_formula,
  data = baseline_data,
  method = "nearest",
  distance = "glm",
  link = "logit",
  ratio = 10,
  replace = FALSE,
  caliper = 0.2
)

print(summary(match_out))

# ============================================================
# 4. Unified theme parameters
# ============================================================

FONT_FAMILY <- "sans"
FONT_SIZE_BASE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_TITLE <- 12
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT <- 9
FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE <- 10
FONT_SIZE_LEGEND <- 9
FONT_SIZE_CAPTION <- 8
LINE_WIDTH_AXIS <- 0.5
LINE_WIDTH_ERROR <- 0.8
POINT_SIZE <- 1.5
POINT_STROKE <- 1.2

FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH <- unit(1.2, "cm")
FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH <- unit(1.5, "cm")

PLOT_MARGIN <- margin(12, 40, 12, 20)
# ============================================================
# Unified output size for Panel A and Panel B
# ============================================================

PANEL_WIDTH <- 7
PANEL_HEIGHT <- 4.8
# ============================================================
# 5. PANEL A: BALANCE PLOT
# ============================================================

bal_tab_result <- bal.tab(match_out, un = TRUE, thresholds = c(m = 0.1))

bal_check <- bal_tab_result$Balance %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  filter(Variable != "distance") %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, Diff.Un, Diff.Adj) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_un = abs(Diff.Un),
    abs_adj = abs(Diff.Adj),
    worsened = abs_adj > abs_un
  )

print(bal_check)

balance_df <- bal_tab_result$Balance %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  filter(Variable != "distance") %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, Unadjusted = Diff.Un, Adjusted = Diff.Adj) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable_clean = case_when(
      Variable == "Capacity_MW" ~ "Capacity (MW)",
      Variable == "Start_year" ~ "Commission Year",
      Variable == "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh" ~ "Heat Rate (Btu/kWh)",
      Variable == "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ" ~ "Emission Factor (kg CO<sub>2</sub>/TJ)",
      Variable == "rGDP_pc" ~ "GDP per capita",
      Variable == "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw" ~ "Electricity price",
      Variable == "td_loss_pct_output" ~ "T&D losses",
      Variable == "demand_yoy_pct" ~ "Electricity demand growth",
      Variable == "renew_gen_share_pct" ~ "Renewable generation share",
      TRUE ~ Variable
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Unadjusted, Adjusted),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "SMD"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable_clean = factor(
      Variable_clean,
      levels = rev(c(
        "Capacity (MW)",
        "Commission Year",
        "Heat Rate (Btu/kWh)",
        "Emission Factor (kg CO<sub>2</sub>/TJ)",
        "GDP per capita",
        "Electricity price",
        "T&D losses",
        "Electricity demand growth",
        "Renewable generation share"
      ))
    ),
    Sample = factor(Sample, levels = c("Unadjusted", "Adjusted"))
  )

x_breaks <- seq(-0.5, 0.5, by = 0.1)
x_limits <- c(-0.55, 0.55)

p_balance <- ggplot(balance_df, aes(x = SMD, y = Variable_clean, color = Sample, shape = Sample)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "solid",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-0.1, 0.1),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey60",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3.5,
    stroke = 0,
    alpha = 0.85,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Unadjusted" = "#1A05A2", "Adjusted" = "#DE1A58")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Unadjusted" = 16, "Adjusted" = 17)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = x_limits,
    breaks = x_breaks,
    labels = sprintf("%.1f", x_breaks),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized Differences",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Sample",
    shape = "Sample"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = FONT_SIZE_BASE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 4)),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TEXT, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 4)),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_AXIS_TITLE, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = LINE_WIDTH_AXIS),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
    legend.position = c(0.83, 0.22),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_LEGEND, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_LEGEND),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    plot.margin = PLOT_MARGIN,
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

plot_balance_grob <- ggplotGrob(p_balance)
plot_balance_grob$widths[2] <- FIXED_YTITLE_WIDTH
plot_balance_grob$widths[3] <- FIXED_YAXIS_WIDTH

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(path_figures, "sup_fig08_psm_balance.pdf"),
  plot = plot_balance_grob,
  width = PANEL_WIDTH,
  height = PANEL_HEIGHT,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)

print(p_balance)

# ============================================================
# 6. Extract matched sample and run Cox model
# ============================================================

matched_ids <- baseline_data %>%
  mutate(matched = !is.na(match_out$weights) & match_out$weights > 0) %>%
  filter(matched) %>%
  pull(GEM_unit_phase_ID)

matched_data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ = ifelse(
      Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ %in% special_ef_values,
      NA,
      Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(GEM_unit_phase_ID %in% matched_ids)

cat(sprintf(
  "\nMatched observations: %d (%.1f%% of original)\n",
  nrow(matched_data),
  100 * nrow(matched_data) / nrow(data)
))

distances <- c("25km")
types <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")
results_psm_list <- list()

for (dist in distances) {
  
  proximity_vars <- paste0("ai_proximity_", dist, "_", types)
  proximity_formula <- paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + ")
  
  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    proximity_formula,
    " + Capacity_MW",
    " + Start_year",
    " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
    " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
    " + rGDP_pc",
    " + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
    " + td_loss_pct_output",
    " + demand_yoy_pct",
    " + renew_gen_share_pct",
    " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
  )
  
  cox_model_psm <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = matched_data,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )
  
  coef_summary <- summary(cox_model_psm)$coefficients
  has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
  
  for (i in seq_along(types)) {
    
    type <- types[i]
    var_name <- proximity_vars[i]
    
    if (!(var_name %in% rownames(coef_summary))) {
      cat(sprintf("Variable not estimated: %s\n", var_name))
      next
    }
    
    coef_val <- coef_summary[var_name, "coef"]
    se <- if (has_robust) coef_summary[var_name, "robust se"] else coef_summary[var_name, "se(coef)"]
    pval <- coef_summary[var_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    results_psm_list[[length(results_psm_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Specification = dist,
      Type = type,
      Variable = var_name,
      Coefficient = coef_val,
      HR = exp(coef_val),
      SE = se,
      CI_lower = exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se),
      CI_upper = exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se),
      P_value = pval,
      Sig = case_when(
        pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
        pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      N_obs = cox_model_psm$n,
      N_events = cox_model_psm$nevent
    )
  }
}

results_psm_df <- bind_rows(results_psm_list)

# ============================================================
# 7. Compare results before and after PSM
# ============================================================

results_original <- readRDS(file.path(path_temp, "cox_baseline_spatial_results.rds")) %>%

comparison_df <- results_original %>%

  ) %>%
  left_join(
    results_psm_df %>%

        CI_upper_psm = CI_upper,
        P_psm = P_value,
        Sig_psm = Sig
      ),
    by = c("Type", "Variable")
  )

print(
  comparison_df %>%
    dplyr::select(Type, HR_original, HR_psm, Sig_original, Sig_psm)
)

# ============================================================
# 8. PANEL B: FOREST PLOT
# ============================================================

nature_colors <- c(
  "before06" = "#000080",
  "06_15" = "#4169E1",
  "16_19" = "#9E1C60",
  "20_24" = "#FF4500"

plot_comparison_data <- comparison_df %>%

x_min <- min(

)

x_range <- x_max - x_min

plot_comparison_data <- plot_comparison_data %>%

forest_plot_psm <- ggplot(plot_comparison_data, aes(y = plot_order)) +
```
