```{r sup_fig08_psm_forest}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)

# ============================================================
# Focused capacity sensitivity: scenarios 1-6
#
# Panel a: capacity assumptions for six scenarios
# Panel b: no commissioning-period split
# Panel c: larger data centers by commissioning period
#
# Capacity exposure uses capacity x inverse-distance weighting
# within the 25 km buffer (Method = "dw").
#
# Requires:
#   data, path_temp, path_tables and path_figures
# ============================================================

capacity_scenarios <- 1:6
capacity_method <- "dw"

controls <- c(
  "Capacity_MW",
  "Start_year",
  "Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
  "Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
  "rGDP_pc",
  "elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
  "td_loss_pct_output",
  "demand_yoy_pct",
  "renew_gen_share_pct"
)

survival_vars <- c(
  "time0",
  "time1",
  "retire",
  "Alpha_3_code",
  "GEM_unit_phase_ID"
)

controls_formula <- paste(
  c(controls, "strata(Alpha_3_code)"),
  collapse = " + "
)

sig_symbol <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p < 0.10 ~ "+",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

check_variables <- function(df, vars) {
  missing_vars <- setdiff(vars, names(df))
  if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing variables:\n",
      paste(missing_vars, collapse = "\n")
    )
  }
}

make_info <- function(exposure_group, period, scenario) {
  data.frame(
    Exposure_group = exposure_group,
    Period = period,
    Method = capacity_method,
    Scenario = paste0("C", scenario),
    Specification = paste0("Capacity scenario ", scenario),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

run_standardized_cox <- function(
    df,
    exposure_vars,
    exposure_info,
    model_id,
    analysis_group
) {
  check_variables(
    df,
    c(exposure_vars, controls, survival_vars)
  )

  if (length(exposure_vars) != nrow(exposure_info)) {
    stop("exposure_vars and exposure_info have different lengths.")
  }

  model_data <- df
  z_vars <- paste0("zexp_", seq_along(exposure_vars))
  scale_info <- vector("list", length(exposure_vars))

  for (i in seq_along(exposure_vars)) {
    source_var <- exposure_vars[i]
    source_mean <- mean(model_data[[source_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    source_sd <- sd(model_data[[source_var]], na.rm = TRUE)

    if (!is.finite(source_sd) || source_sd <= 0) {
      stop(sprintf("%s has zero or invalid standard deviation.", source_var))
    }

    model_data[[z_vars[i]]] <- (
      model_data[[source_var]] - source_mean
    ) / source_sd

    scale_info[[i]] <- data.frame(
      Variable = source_var,
      Exposure_mean = source_mean,
      Exposure_SD = source_sd,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  formula_str <- paste0(
    "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
    paste(z_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " + ",
    controls_formula
  )

  fit <- coxph(
    as.formula(formula_str),
    data = model_data,
    cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
    ties = "efron",
    control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
  )

  coef_table <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  se_column <- if ("robust se" %in% colnames(coef_table)) {
    "robust se"
  } else {
    "se(coef)"
  }

  result_rows <- lapply(
    seq_along(exposure_vars),
    function(i) {
      beta <- coef_table[z_vars[i], "coef"]
      se <- coef_table[z_vars[i], se_column]
      p_value <- coef_table[z_vars[i], "Pr(>|z|)"]

      bind_cols(
        exposure_info[i, , drop = FALSE],
        scale_info[[i]],
        data.frame(
          Model_ID = model_id,
          Analysis_group = analysis_group,
          Coefficient = beta,
          SE = se,
          HR = exp(beta),
          CI_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
          CI_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * se),
          P_value = p_value,
          Sig = sig_symbol(p_value),
          N_obs = fit$n,
          N_events = fit$nevent,
          Formula = formula_str,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      )
    }
  )

  list(
    model = fit,
    results = bind_rows(result_rows)
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 1. Run required models
# ============================================================

focused_results <- list()
focused_models <- list()

for (scenario in capacity_scenarios) {
  cat("\nRunning capacity scenario", scenario, "\n")

  # Panel b model 1: all data centers, no period split
  all_var <- paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "_25km_all")
  model_id <- paste0("no_period_all_c", scenario, "_", capacity_method)

  out <- run_standardized_cox(
    df = data,
    exposure_vars = all_var,
    exposure_info = make_info("All data centers", "All periods", scenario),
    model_id = model_id,
    analysis_group = "No period split"
  )

  focused_results[[length(focused_results) + 1]] <- out$results
  focused_models[[model_id]] <- out$model

  # Panel b model 2: larger + other, no period split
  larger_all_var <- paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "l_25km_all")
  other_all_var <- paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "o_25km_all")
  model_id <- paste0("no_period_larger_other_c", scenario, "_", capacity_method)

  out <- run_standardized_cox(
    df = data,
    exposure_vars = c(larger_all_var, other_all_var),
    exposure_info = bind_rows(
      make_info("Larger data centers", "All periods", scenario),
      make_info("Other data centers", "All periods", scenario)
    ),
    model_id = model_id,
    analysis_group = "No period split"
  )

  focused_results[[length(focused_results) + 1]] <- out$results
  focused_models[[model_id]] <- out$model

  # Panel c: larger + other jointly by three periods
  larger_before06 <- paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "l_25km_before06")
  larger_0615 <- paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "l_25km_06_15")
  other_before06 <- paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "o_25km_before06")
  other_0615 <- paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "o_25km_06_15")

  check_variables(
    data,
    c(larger_before06, larger_0615, other_before06, other_0615)
  )

  model_data <- data

  larger_pre_var <- paste0("capacity_larger_pre_c", scenario, "_", capacity_method)
  other_pre_var <- paste0("capacity_other_pre_c", scenario, "_", capacity_method)

  model_data[[larger_pre_var]] <- rowSums(
    model_data[c(larger_before06, larger_0615)],
    na.rm = FALSE
  )

  model_data[[other_pre_var]] <- rowSums(
    model_data[c(other_before06, other_0615)],
    na.rm = FALSE
  )

  exposure_vars <- c(
    larger_pre_var,
    paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "l_25km_16_19"),
    paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "l_25km_20_24"),
    other_pre_var,
    paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "o_25km_16_19"),
    paste0("ai_c", scenario, capacity_method, "o_25km_20_24")
  )

  exposure_info <- bind_rows(
    make_info("Larger data centers", "Pre-2016", scenario),
    make_info("Larger data centers", "2016-2019", scenario),
    make_info("Larger data centers", "2020-2024", scenario),
    make_info("Other data centers", "Pre-2016", scenario),
    make_info("Other data centers", "2016-2019", scenario),
    make_info("Other data centers", "2020-2024", scenario)
  )

  model_id <- paste0("three_period_larger_other_c", scenario, "_", capacity_method)

  out <- run_standardized_cox(
    df = model_data,
    exposure_vars = exposure_vars,
    exposure_info = exposure_info,
    model_id = model_id,
    analysis_group = "Three periods: larger versus other"
  )

  focused_results[[length(focused_results) + 1]] <- out$results
  focused_models[[model_id]] <- out$model
}

capacity_results_c1_c6 <- bind_rows(focused_results)

saveRDS(
  capacity_results_c1_c6,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig10_capacity_results.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  focused_models,
  file.path(path_temp, "sup_fig10_capacity_models.rds")
)

write.csv(
  capacity_results_c1_c6,
  file.path(path_tables, "sup_fig10_capacity_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nFocused capacity analysis completed.\n",
  "Models fitted: ",
  length(focused_models),
  "\nCoefficient rows: ",
  nrow(capacity_results_c1_c6),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```


```{r sup_fig10_capacity_sensitivity}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# Capacity sensitivity figure
#
# Panel a: capacity assumptions for six scenarios
# Panel b: no commissioning-period split
# Panel c: larger data centers by commissioning period
#
# This script reads saved C1-C6 results only and does not refit models.
# ============================================================

capacity_results <- readRDS(
  file.path(
    path_temp,
    "sup_fig10_capacity_results.rds"
  )
)

scenario_levels <- paste0("C", 1:6)

scenario_labels <- c(
  "C1" = "Scenario 1",
  "C2" = "Scenario 2",
  "C3" = "Scenario 3",
  "C4" = "Scenario 4",
  "C5" = "Scenario 5",
  "C6" = "Scenario 6"
)

scenario_colors <- c(
  "C1" = "#093C5D",
  "C2" = "#3B7597",
  "C3" = "#6FD1D7",
  "C4" = "#5DF8D8",
  "C5" = "#8ED081",
  "C6" = "#D6D65C"
)

scenario_offsets <- c(
  "C1" = 0.25,
  "C2" = 0.15,
  "C3" = 0.05,
  "C4" = -0.05,
  "C5" = -0.15,
  "C6" = -0.25
)

capacity_assumptions <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Scenario, ~Capacity_level, ~Annual_growth,
  ~`Hyperscale/cloud`, ~Wholesale, ~`Retail/other`, ~Crypto,
  "C1", "Lower",  "10%",  40,   5, 1,  30,
  "C2", "Lower",  "30%",  40,   5, 1,  30,
  "C3", "Lower",  "50%",  40,   5, 1,  30,
  "C4", "Higher", "10%", 100,  50, 5, 100,
  "C5", "Higher", "30%", 100,  50, 5, 100,
  "C6", "Higher", "50%", 100,  50, 5, 100
) %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = scenario_levels),
    Scenario_label = unname(scenario_labels[as.character(Scenario)])
  )

theme_capacity_focused <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 9, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 9.5,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(b = 7)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 7)),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.45),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.45),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey91", linewidth = 0.28),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.40, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 36, 8, 8)
    )
}

prepare_plot_limits <- function(df, right_padding = 0.30) {
  x_min <- min(df$CI_lower, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(df$CI_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_range <- x_max - x_min

  if (!is.finite(x_range) || x_range <= 0) {
    x_range <- 0.1
  }

  x_limit_min <- max(0.05, min(x_min, 1) - 0.08 * x_range)
  x_limit_max <- max(x_max, 1) + right_padding * x_range

  list(
    min = x_limit_min,
    max = x_limit_max,
    range = x_limit_max - x_limit_min
  )
}

capacity_results_plot <- capacity_results %>%
  mutate(
    Scenario = factor(as.character(Scenario), levels = scenario_levels)
  )

# ============================================================
# PANEL A
# Scenario assumptions
# ============================================================

table_columns <- c(
  "Scenario",
  "Capacity\nlevel",
  "Annual growth\nafter 2020",
  "Hyperscale/\ncloud",
  "Wholesale",
  "Retail/\nother",
  "Crypto"
)

table_values <- capacity_assumptions %>%
  transmute(
    Row = rev(seq_len(n())),
    Scenario = Scenario_label,
    `Capacity\nlevel` = Capacity_level,
    `Annual growth\nafter 2020` = Annual_growth,
    `Hyperscale/\ncloud` = as.character(`Hyperscale/cloud`),
    Wholesale = as.character(Wholesale),
    `Retail/\nother` = as.character(`Retail/other`),
    Crypto = as.character(Crypto)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Row,
    names_to = "Column",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Column = factor(Column, levels = table_columns),
    Column_number = as.numeric(Column),
    Scenario_id = rep(scenario_levels, each = length(table_columns)),
    Row_group = if_else(Row >= 4, "Lower", "Higher")
  )

header_data <- tibble(
  Column = factor(table_columns, levels = table_columns),
  Column_number = seq_along(table_columns),
  Row = 7,
  Value = table_columns
)

plot_a <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = table_values,
    aes(x = Column_number, y = Row, fill = Scenario_id),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.14
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = header_data,
    aes(x = Column_number, y = Row),
    fill = "grey93",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = table_values,
    aes(x = Column_number, y = Row, label = Value),
    size = 2.55,
    family = "sans",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = header_data,
    aes(x = Column_number, y = Row, label = Value),
    size = 2.45,
    family = "sans",
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 3.5,
    color = "grey55",
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = scenario_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 7.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 7.65), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "a  Assumed data-center capacity scenarios") +
  theme_void(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 9.5,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 5)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 8, 5, 8)
  )

# ============================================================
# PANEL B
# Capacity exposure without commissioning-period distinction
# ============================================================

panel_b_order_bottom_to_top <- c(
  "Other data centers",
  "Larger data centers",
  "All data centers"
)

panel_b_data <- capacity_results_plot %>%
  filter(
    Analysis_group == "No period split",
    Method == "dw",
    Scenario %in% scenario_levels
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Exposure_group = factor(
      Exposure_group,
      levels = panel_b_order_bottom_to_top
    ),
    y_base = as.numeric(Exposure_group),
    y_pos = y_base + unname(scenario_offsets[as.character(Scenario)]),
    Result_label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig)
  )

if (nrow(panel_b_data) == 0) {
  stop("No no-period capacity-weighted results found for scenarios C1-C6.")
}

limits_b <- prepare_plot_limits(panel_b_data)

panel_b_data <- panel_b_data %>%
  mutate(label_x = CI_upper + 0.022 * limits_b$range)

plot_b <- ggplot(panel_b_data, aes(color = Scenario)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.48) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = CI_lower, xend = CI_upper, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos),
    linewidth = 0.75,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = HR, y = y_pos),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.85,
    stroke = 0.85,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, y = y_pos, label = Result_label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2.15,
    color = "black",
    family = "sans",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = scenario_colors,
    labels = scenario_labels,
    breaks = scenario_levels
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(panel_b_order_bottom_to_top),
    labels = panel_b_order_bottom_to_top,
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.55, 0.55))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(limits_b$min, limits_b$max),
    breaks = sort(unique(c(pretty(c(limits_b$min, limits_b$max), n = 5), 1))),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "b  Capacity-weighted DCE without period distinction",
    x = paste0(
      "Hazard ratio per 1-SD increase in ",
      "capacity-weighted DCE (95% CI)"
    )
  ) +
  theme_capacity_focused()

# ============================================================
# PANEL C
# Larger data centers by commissioning period
# ============================================================

panel_c_order_bottom_to_top <- c(
  "2020-2024",
  "2016-2019",
  "Pre-2016"
)

panel_c_data <- capacity_results_plot %>%
  filter(
    Analysis_group == "Three periods: larger versus other",
    Exposure_group == "Larger data centers",
    Method == "dw",
    Scenario %in% scenario_levels
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Period = factor(Period, levels = panel_c_order_bottom_to_top),
    y_base = as.numeric(Period),
    y_pos = y_base + unname(scenario_offsets[as.character(Scenario)]),
    Result_label = sprintf("%.2f%s", HR, Sig)
  )

if (nrow(panel_c_data) == 0) {
  stop("No three-period larger-data-center results found for scenarios C1-C6.")
}

limits_c <- prepare_plot_limits(panel_c_data)

panel_c_data <- panel_c_data %>%
  mutate(label_x = CI_upper + 0.022 * limits_c$range)

plot_c <- ggplot(panel_c_data, aes(color = Scenario)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.48) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = CI_lower, xend = CI_upper, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos),
    linewidth = 0.75,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = HR, y = y_pos),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.85,
    stroke = 0.85,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, y = y_pos, label = Result_label),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2.15,
    color = "black",
    family = "sans",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = scenario_colors,
    labels = scenario_labels,
    breaks = scenario_levels
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(panel_c_order_bottom_to_top),
    labels = panel_c_order_bottom_to_top,
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.55, 0.55))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(limits_c$min, limits_c$max),
    breaks = sort(unique(c(pretty(c(limits_c$min, limits_c$max), n = 5), 1))),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "c  Capacity-weighted larger-data-center DCE by period",
    x = paste0(
      "Hazard ratio per 1-SD increase in ",
      "capacity-weighted DCE (95% CI)"
    )
  ) +
  theme_capacity_focused()

capacity_focused_figure <- (
  plot_a /
    plot_b /
    plot_c
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(1.05, 1.35, 1.35),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(path_figures, "sup_fig10_capacity_sensitivity.pdf"),
```
